Baski so napadli iz maščevanja, ker je Karel Veliki porušil obzidje njihove prestolnice Pamplone. Ko so se Franki čez Pireneje umikali nazaj v Frankovsko, so frankovske gospode v zaledni straži odrezali, ti so vztrajali na položaju in bili pobiti. Med padlimi je bil frankovski poveljnik Roland. Njegova smrt je njega in paladine, najodličnejše bojevnike dvora Karla Velikega, povzdignila v legendo; postali so vzor vitezov in močno vplivali na viteški kodeks v srednjem veku.

source.title: Battle of Roncevaux Pass
paragraphs: The Battle of Roncevaux Pass (French and English spelling, Roncesvalles in Spanish, Orreaga in Basque) in 778 saw a large force of Basques ambush a part of Charlemagne's army in Roncevaux Pass, a high mountain pass in the Pyrenees on the present border between France and Spain, after his invasion of the Iberian Peninsula.

The Basque attack was in retaliation for Charlemagne's destruction of the city walls of their capital, Pamplona. As the Franks retreated across the Pyrenees back to Francia, the rearguard of Frankish lords was cut off, stood its ground, and was wiped out. Among those killed in the battle was Roland, a Frankish commander. His death elevated him and the paladins, the foremost warriors of Charlemagne's court, into legend, becoming the quintessential role model for knights and also greatly influencing the code of chivalry in the Middle Ages.

Battle of Sagrajas.headline: Bitka pri Sagrajasu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sagrajasu (23. oktobra 1086), imenovana tudi Zalaca ali Zalaka (arabsko: معركة الزلاقة), je bila spopad leta 1086 med almoravidsko vojsko pod vodstvom njihovega kralja Jusufa ibn Tašfina in silami kastiljskega kralja Alfonza VI. Almoravide so v boj poklicale taife, muslimanske kneževine v Al Andalusu, ki so se pogosto bojevale med seboj, proti širjenju krščanskih kraljestev na severu pa so se združile. Poleg almoravidskih sil so muslimansko stran okrepile tudi taife in tehtnico prevesile v njeno korist. Bojišče je postalo znano kot az Zalaka (»spolzka tla«), ker je bilo zaradi ogromnega prelivanja krvi zahrbtno, od tod tudi arabsko ime.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Sagrajas
paragraphs: The Battle of Sagrajas (23 October 1086), also called Zalaca or Zallaqah (Arabic: معركة الزلاقة, romanized: Maʿrakat az-Zallāqah), was a conflict fought in 1086 between the Almoravid army, led by their king, Yusuf ibn Tashfin, and the forces of King Alfonso VI of Castile. The Almoravids were called into battle by the taifas, Muslim principalities in Al-Andalus that often fought amongst themselves but united against the expanding Christian kingdoms to the north. In addition to the Almoravid forces, the Taifas, bolstered the Muslim side, tilting the battle in their favor. The battlefield became known as az-Zallaqah (meaning "slippery ground") due to the immense bloodshed that made the terrain treacherous, giving rise to its name in Arabic.

Bitka pri Salamanci (v francoščini in španščini znana kot bitka pri Arapilesu) je potekala 22. julija 1812. Angleško-portugalska vojska pod grofom Wellingtonom (poznejšim vojvodo Wellingtonom) je med polotoško vojno pri Arapilesu južno od Salamance v Španiji premagala francoske sile maršala Augusta Marmonta. Navzoča je bila tudi španska divizija, ki pa v bitki ni sodelovala.

source.title: Battle of Salamanca
paragraphs: The Battle of Salamanca (in French and Spanish known as the Battle of the Arapiles) took place on 22 July 1812. An Anglo-Portuguese army under the Earl of Wellington (future Duke of Wellington) defeated Marshal Auguste Marmont's French forces at Arapiles, south of Salamanca, Spain, during the Peninsular War. A Spanish division was also present but took no part in the battle.

Battle of Sandwich (1217).headline: Bitka pri Sandwichu (1217)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sandwichu, imenovana tudi bitka pri Dovru, je potekala 24. avgusta 1217 v prvi baronski vojni. Angleško plantagenetsko ladjevje pod poveljstvom Huberta de Burgha je pred Sandwichem v Kentu napadlo francosko kapetinško ladjevje pod vodstvom Eustahija Meniha in Roberta de Courtenayja. Angleži so zajeli francosko admiralsko ladjo in večino oskrbovalnih ladij, preostanek francoskega ladjevja pa se je moral vrniti v Calais.

Francosko ladjevje je skušalo pripeljati zaloge in okrepitve princu Ludviku, poznejšemu francoskemu kralju Ludviku VIII., čigar francoske sile so tedaj držale London. Angleške ladje so napadle s privetrne strani, zavzele Eustahijevo ladjo, ujele Roberta in viteze ter pobile preostalo posadko. Eustahija, razvpitega pirata, so po ujetju usmrtili. Bitka je princa Ludvika prepričala, da opusti poskus osvojitve Anglije, nekaj tednov pozneje pa je bila podpisana lambethska pogodba.

source.title: Battle of Sandwich (1217)
paragraphs: The Battle of Sandwich, also called the Battle of Dover took place on 24 August 1217 as part of the First Barons' War. A Plantagenet English fleet commanded by Hubert de Burgh attacked a Capetian French fleet led by Eustace the Monk and Robert of Courtenay off Sandwich, Kent. The English captured the French flagship and most of the supply vessels, forcing the rest of the French fleet to return to Calais.

The French fleet was attempting to bring supplies and reinforcements to Prince Louis, later King Louis VIII of France, whose French forces held London at that time. The English vessels attacked from windward, seizing Eustace's ship, making Robert and the knights prisoner and killing the rest of the crew. Eustace, a notorious pirate, was executed after being taken prisoner. The battle convinced Prince Louis to abandon his effort to conquer England and the Treaty of Lambeth was signed a few weeks later.

Battle of Santander.headline: Bitka za Santander
paragraphs: Bitka za Santander se je odvila poleti 1937 v okviru kampanje vojne na severu v španski državljanski vojni in se končala z zmago italijanskih in nacionalističnih sil nad republikanci. Padec Santandra 26. avgusta je nacionalistom zagotovil osvojitev province Santander, današnje Kantabrije. Bitka je uničila republikansko »severno armado«; ujetih je bilo 60.000 vojakov, med njimi baskovske sile, ki so se 25. avgusta predale Italijanom.

source.title: Battle of Santander
paragraphs: The Battle of Santander was fought in the War in the North campaign of the Spanish Civil War during the summer of 1937 and saw the victory of Italian and Nationalist forces against the Republicans. Santander's fall on 26 August assured the Nationalist conquest of the province of Santander, now Cantabria. The battle devastated the Republic's "Army of the North"; 60,000 soldiers were captured, among them the Basque forces which surrendered to the Italians on August 25.

Bitka pri São Mamede (portugalsko: Batalha de São Mamede) je potekala 24. junija 1128 blizu Guimarãesa in velja za pomemben dogodek v procesu, ki je privedel do nastanka Portugalske kot samostojnega kraljestva.

Sile pod vodstvom Afonsa Henriquesa so premagale sile njegove matere Terezije Portugalske in Fernãa Peresa de Trave. Afonso je sicer prevzel nadzor nad grofijo Portugalsko, a je ostal vazal leonsko-kastiljskega kralja Alfonza VII., ki je bil formalno nadoblastnik grofije.

Afonso Henriques je po bitki utrdil nadzor nad grofijo Portugalsko. Po zmagi v bitki pri Ouriqueu leta 1139 je prevzel naslov portugalskega kralja, leonsko-kastiljski kralj Alfonz VII. pa je njegov kraljevski naslov priznal z zamorsko pogodbo leta 1143.

source.title: Battle of São Mamede
paragraphs: The Battle of São Mamede (Portuguese: Batalha de São Mamede) took place on 24 June 1128 near Guimarães and is considered an important event in the process that led to the establishment of Portugal as an independent kingdom.

Forces led by Afonso Henriques defeated forces led by his mother, Theresa of Portugal, and Fernão Peres de Trava. Though he took control of the County of Portugal, he remained a vassal of King Alfonso VII of León and Castile, who was nominally the overlord of the county.

Following the battle, Afonso Henriques consolidated his control over the County of Portugal. He later adopted the title of King of Portugal, following his victory at the Battle of Ourique in 1139, and his royal title was recognized by Alfonso VII of León and Castile in the Treaty of Zamora in 1143.

Bitka pri Zaragozi 20. avgusta 1710 je potekala v vojni za špansko nasledstvo blizu Zaragoze v Španiji. Sile velike alianse pod Guidom Starhembergom, med katerimi so bile tudi habsburške španske enote, so hudo porazile nekoliko šibkejšo francosko-burbonsko špansko vojsko pod poveljstvom markiza de Baya.

Zmaga je zaveznikom omogočila vstop v Madrid, a so se morali zaradi pomanjkanja zalog umakniti, porazi pri Brihuegi novembra in pri Villaviciosi decembra pa so dejansko pokopali upanje, da bi odstavili španskega kralja Filipa V. Markiz de Bay se je s silami alianse spopadel že prej: uspešno je oblegal Ciudad Rodrigo in jih premagal pri La Gudiñi. Bitka pri Zaragozi je Starhemberga uvrstila med sposobne poveljnike svojega časa.
notes: The English text spells the marquis both de Bay and de Bey; the Slovenian uses de Bay throughout.

source.title: Battle of Saragossa
paragraphs: The Battle of Saragossa, 20 August 1710, took place during the War of the Spanish Succession, near Zaragoza in Spain. A slightly inferior Franco-Bourbon Spanish army commanded by the Marquis de Bay was severely defeated by a Grand Alliance force under Guido Starhemberg, which included Habsburg Spanish troops.

Victory allowed the Allies to enter Madrid, but lack of supplies forced them to retreat, while defeats at Brihuega in November and Villaviciosa in December effectively ended hopes of deposing Philip V of Spain. The Marquis de Bey had already faced the forces of the alliance; he had successfully besieged Ciudad Rodrigo and defeated them at La Gudiña. Saragossa placed Starhemberg among the capable commanders from his time.

Battle of Sedgemoor.headline: Bitka pri Sedgemooru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sedgemooru je bila zadnji in odločilni spopad Monmouthovega upora med silami, zvestimi Jakobu II., in uporniškimi silami pod vodstvom vojvode Monmoutha. Potekala je 6. julija 1685 pri Westonzoylandu blizu Bridgwatra v Somersetu v Angliji.

Bitki je predhodila vrsta prask med obema silama na jugozahodu Anglije. Sile kralja Jakoba so zmagale in zajele okoli 500 ujetnikov. Monmouth je pobegnil z bojišča, a so ga ujeli, odpeljali v London in devet dni pozneje usmrtili. Številnim Monmouthovim privržencem so sodili na krvavih sodnih zasedanjih (Bloody Assizes). Veliko so jih izgnali v tujino, druge pa usmrtili z vlečenjem in razčetverjenjem.

source.title: Battle of Sedgemoor
paragraphs: The Battle of Sedgemoor was the final and decisive engagement of the Monmouth Rebellion, between forces loyal to James II and rebel forces led by the Duke of Monmouth. It was fought on 6 July 1685 at Westonzoyland near Bridgwater in Somerset, England.

The battle followed a series of skirmishes around south-west England between these two forces. King James' forces won the battle, and took about 500 prisoners. Monmouth escaped from the battlefield but was captured, taken to London and executed nine days later. Many of Monmouth's supporters were tried during the Bloody Assizes. Many were transported abroad, while others were executed by drawing and quartering.

Battle of Sheriffmuir.headline: Bitka pri Sheriffmuirju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sheriffmuirju (škotsko gelsko: Blàr Sliabh an t-Siorraim) je bila spopad leta 1715 na vrhuncu jakobitskega upora na Škotskem. Bojišče je vpisano v Popis zgodovinskih bojišč na Škotskem in ga po škotski politiki zgodovinskega okolja iz leta 2009 varuje ustanova Historic Scotland. Sheriffmuir je odmaknjena dvignjena planota resave med Stirlingom in Auchterarderjem na severnem robu gričevja Ochil Hills.
notes: The Gaelic pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Sheriffmuir
paragraphs: The Battle of Sheriffmuir (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Sliabh an t-Siorraim, [pl̪ˠaɾ ˈʃʎiəv əɲ ˈtʲʰirˠəm]) was an engagement in 1715 at the height of the Jacobite rising in Scotland. The battlefield has been included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009. Sheriffmuir is a remote elevated plateau of moorland lying between Stirling and Auchterarder on the north fringe of the Ochil Hills.

Battle of Shrewsbury.headline: Bitka pri Shrewsburyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Shrewsburyju je potekala 21. julija 1403 med vojsko lancastrskega kralja Henrika IV. in uporniško vojsko pod vodstvom Henryja »Harryja Hotspurja« Percyja iz Northumberlanda. Bitka, prva, v kateri so se angleški lokostrelci bojevali drug proti drugemu na angleških tleh, je znova potrdila učinkovitost dolgega loka in končala Percyjev izziv angleškemu kralju Henriku IV. Del bojev naj bi potekal na območju današnjega kraja Battlefield v Shropshiru v Angliji, tri milje (5 km) severno od središča Shrewsburyja. Danes ga zaznamujeta cerkev Battlefield Church in dediščinski park Battlefield Heritage Park.

source.title: Battle of Shrewsbury
paragraphs: The Battle of Shrewsbury was fought on 21 July 1403, waged between an army led by the Lancastrian King Henry IV and a rebel army led by Henry "Harry Hotspur" Percy from Northumberland. The battle, the first in which English archers fought each other on English soil, reaffirmed the effectiveness of the longbow and ended the Percy challenge to King Henry IV of England. Part of the fighting is believed to have taken place at what is now Battlefield, Shropshire, England, three miles (5 km) north of the centre of Shrewsbury. It is marked today by Battlefield Church and Battlefield Heritage Park.

Battle of Simancas.headline: Bitka pri Simancasu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Simancasu (imenovana tudi Alhandega ali al Handak) je bila vojaška bitka, ki se je 19. julija 939 začela na Iberskem polotoku med enotami leonskega kralja Ramira II. in kordobskega kalifa Abd al Rahmana III. pod obzidjem mesta Simancas.

Bitka se je razvila, potem ko je vojska Abd al Rahmana III. leta 934 krenila proti severnim krščanskim ozemljem. Abd al Rahman III. je s pomočjo andaluzijskega upravitelja Zaragoze Mohameda ibn Jahje al Tudžibija zbral veliko kalifsko vojsko. Leonski kralj Ramiro II. je vodil protinapad z vojsko, ki so jo sestavljale njegove lastne enote, kastiljske pod grofom Fernánom Gonzálezom in navarske pod Garcío Sánchezom I.
Mavrski pričevalci so zabeležili veličasten sončni mrk, ki se je zgodil prvi dan bitke.
notes: The English excerpt ends with a colon before a quotation it leaves out; the Slovenian ends the sentence with a full stop.

source.title: Battle of Simancas
paragraphs: The Battle of Simancas (also called Alhandega or al-Khandaq) was a military battle that started on 19 July 939 in the Iberian Peninsula between the troops of the King of León Ramiro II and Cordovan caliph Abd al-Rahman III near the walls of the city of Simancas.

The battle unfolded after the army of Abd al-Rahman III launched toward the northern Christian territories in 934. Abd al-Rahman III had gathered a large army of caliphal fighters, with the help of the Andalusi governor of Zaragoza, Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Tujibi. The Leonese king Ramiro II led the counterattack with an army consisting of his own troops, those of Castile under Count Fernán González, and the Navarrese under García Sánchez I.

Bitka v Solebayju je potekala 6. junija 1672 po gregorijanskem koledarju v tretji angleško-nizozemski vojni blizu Southwolda v Suffolku na vzhodu Anglije. Nizozemsko ladjevje pod Michielom de Ruyterjem je napadlo združene angleško-francoske sile v eni največjih pomorskih bitk dobe jadrnic. Boji so trajali večji del dneva, a so se ob sončnem zahodu končali brez jasne zmage. Razpršeno zavezniško ladjevje pa je utrpelo precej večjo škodo in je moralo opustiti vse načrte za izkrcanje enot na nizozemski obali.

source.title: Battle of Solebay
paragraphs: The Battle of Solebay took place on 6 June 1672 New Style, during the Third Anglo-Dutch War, near Southwold, Suffolk, in eastern England. A Dutch fleet under Michiel de Ruyter attacked a combined Anglo-French force in one of the largest naval battles of the Age of Sail. Fighting continued much of the day, but ended at sunset without a clear victory. However, the scattered Allied fleet had suffered far more damage and was forced to abandon any plans to land troops on the Dutch coast.

Battle of Solway Moss.headline: Bitka pri Solway Mossu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Solway Mossu je potekala novembra 1542 med angleškimi in škotskimi silami na barju Solway Moss blizu reke Esk na angleški strani angleško-škotske meje.

Škotski kralj Jakob V. se ni hotel odreči katoliški Cerkvi, kot ga je spodbujal njegov stric, angleški kralj Henrik VIII., ki je nato sprožil velik vpad na jugozahod Škotske. Škotska vojska, ki je krenila proti Angležem, je bila slabo vodena in organizirana, veliko Škotov so ujeli ali pa so utonili v reki. Novica o porazu naj bi pospešila zgodnjo smrt Jakoba V.

source.title: Battle of Solway Moss
paragraphs: The Battle of Solway Moss took place on Solway Moss near the River Esk on the English side of the Anglo-Scottish border in November 1542 between English and Scottish forces.

The Scottish King James V had refused to break from the Catholic Church, as urged by his uncle King Henry VIII, who then launched a major raid into south-west Scotland. The Scottish army that marched against them was poorly led and organised, and many Scots were either captured or drowned in the river. News of the defeat is believed to have hastened the early death of James V.

Battle of Somosierra.headline: Bitka pri Somosierri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Somosierri je potekala 30. novembra 1808 v polotoški vojni, ko so združene sile Francozov, napoleonskih Špancev in Poljakov pod neposrednim poveljstvom Napoleona I. prebile pot skozi špansko divizijo v pogorju Sierra de Guadarrama, ki je Madrid ščitilo pred neposrednim francoskim napadom. Na gorskem prelazu Somosierra, 97 kilometrov severno od Madrida, je številčno močno šibkejši španski oddelek rednih vojakov, prostovoljcev in topništva pod Benitom de San Juanom skušal zapreti Napoleonovo pot proti Madridu. Napoleon je španske položaje strl s kombiniranim napadom: poljske lahke konjenike (chevau-légers) cesarske garde je poslal nad španske topove, francoska pehota pa je napredovala po pobočjih. Zmaga je odstranila zadnjo oviro na cesti proti Madridu, ki je padel nekaj dni pozneje.
notes: The miles (60 mi) are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Somosierra
paragraphs: The Battle of Somosierra took place on 30 November 1808, during the Peninsular War, when a combined Franco-Napoleonic Spanish-Polish force under the direct command of Napoleon I forced a passage through a Spanish division stationed at the Sierra de Guadarrama, which shielded Madrid from direct French attack. At the Somosierra mountain pass, 60 miles (97 km) north of Madrid, a heavily outnumbered Spanish detachment of regulars, volunteers and artillery under Benito de San Juan attempted to block Napoleon's advance onto Madrid. Napoleon overwhelmed the Spanish positions in a combined arms attack, sending the Polish Chevau-légers of the Imperial Guard at the Spanish guns while French infantry advanced up the slopes. The victory removed the last obstacle barring the road to Madrid, which fell a few days later.

Battle of Stamford Bridge.headline: Bitka pri Stamford Bridgeu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Stamford Bridgeu je potekala 25. septembra 1066 pri vasi Stamford Bridge v East Ridingu v Yorkshiru v Angliji med angleško vojsko kralja Harolda Godwinsona in norveško invazijsko vojsko pod vodstvom kralja Haralda Hardrade in brata angleškega kralja Tostiga Godwinsona. V krvavi bitki sta padla Hardrada in Tostig, pa tudi večina Norvežanov. Harold Godwinson je norveške napadalce sicer odbil, a so manj kot tri tedne pozneje Normani pri Hastingsu porazili njegovo vojsko.

Bitko tradicionalno štejejo za konec vikinške dobe, čeprav so v naslednjih desetletjih v Britaniji in na Irskem potekali veliki skandinavski pohodi, denimo danskega kralja Svena Estridsena v letih 1069–1070 in norveškega kralja Magnusa Bosonogega v letih 1098 in 1102–1103.

source.title: Battle of Stamford Bridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Stamford Bridge took place at the village of Stamford Bridge, East Riding of Yorkshire, in England, on 25 September 1066, between an English army under King Harold Godwinson and an invading Norwegian force led by King Harald Hardrada and the English king's brother Tostig Godwinson. After a bloody battle, both Hardrada and Tostig, along with most of the Norwegians, were killed. Although Harold Godwinson repelled the Norwegian invaders, his army was defeated by the Normans at Hastings less than three weeks later.

The battle has traditionally been presented as marking the end of the Viking Age, although major Scandinavian campaigns in Britain and Ireland occurred in the following decades, such as those of King Sweyn Estrithson of Denmark in 1069–1070 and King Magnus Barefoot of Norway in 1098 and 1102–1103.

Battle of Stirling Bridge.headline: Bitka pri Stirlinškem mostu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Stirlinškem mostu (škotsko gelsko: Blàr Drochaid Shruighlea) je potekala v prvi škotski osamosvojitveni vojni. Sile Andrewa Moraya in Williama Wallacea so 11. septembra 1297 blizu Stirlinga ob reki Forth premagale združene angleške sile Johna de Warenna, 6. grofa Surreyja, in Hugha de Cressinghama.

source.title: Battle of Stirling Bridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Stirling Bridge (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Drochaid Shruighlea) was fought during the First War of Scottish Independence. On 11 September 1297, the forces of Andrew Moray and William Wallace defeated the combined English forces of John de Warenne, 6th Earl of Surrey, and Hugh de Cressingham near Stirling, on the River Forth.

Battle of Stoke Field.headline: Bitka pri Stoke Fieldu
paragraphs: Bitko pri Stoke Fieldu, ki je potekala 16. junija 1487 pri East Stoku v Nottinghamshiru, lahko štejemo za zadnjo bitko vojne rož, saj je bila zadnji večji spopad med tekmeci za prestol, katerih zahteve so izhajale iz porekla iz hiš Lancaster in York. Bitka pri Bosworth Fieldu dve leti prej je na prestol postavila Henrika VII., končala zadnje obdobje yorške vladavine in začela tudorsko. Bitka pri Stoke Fieldu je bila odločilni spopad v poskusu vodilnih Rikardu zvestih privržencev Yorkov, da bi kralja odstavili v korist pretendenta Lamberta Simnela.

Čeprav jo pogosto prikazujejo skoraj kot opombo k velikim bitkam med Yorki in Lancastri, je bila morda nekoliko večja od bitke pri Bosworthu in je imela precej več žrtev, morda zaradi terena, ki je obe strani prisilil v tesen, izčrpavajoč boj. Henrikova zmaga je bila nazadnje uničujoča. V bitki so padli skoraj vsi vodilni privrženci Yorkov.

source.title: Battle of Stoke Field
paragraphs: The Battle of Stoke Field, which took place at East Stoke, Nottinghamshire, on 16 June 1487, may be considered the last battle of the Wars of the Roses, since it was the last major engagement between contenders for the throne whose claims derived from descent from the houses of Lancaster and York. The Battle of Bosworth Field, two years previously, had established Henry VII on the throne, ending the last period of Yorkist rule and initiating that of the Tudors. The Battle of Stoke Field was the decisive engagement in an attempt by leading Ricardian Yorkists to unseat the King in favour of the pretender Lambert Simnel.

Though it is often portrayed as almost a footnote to the major battles between York and Lancaster, it may have been slightly larger than Bosworth, with much heavier casualties, possibly because of the terrain which forced the two sides into close, attritional combat. In the end, though, Henry's victory was crushing. Almost all the leading Yorkists were killed in the battle.

Battle of Talavera.headline: Bitka pri Talaveri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Talaveri (27.–28. julija 1809) je potekala tik pred mestom Talavera de la Reina v Španiji, približno 120 kilometrov jugozahodno od Madrida, v polotoški vojni. Britanska vojska pod sirom Arthurjem Wellesleyjem se je pri Talaveri skupaj s špansko vojsko pod generalom Gregoriem Garcío de la Cuesto bojevala v operacijah proti Madridu, ki so ga zasedli Francozi. Ob mraku se je francoska vojska, potem ko so ji odbili več napadov, umaknila za kratko razdaljo; zavezniki, ki so utrpeli podobne izgube kot Francozi, je niso poskušali zasledovati.
notes: The miles conversion (75 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Talavera
paragraphs: The Battle of Talavera (27–28 July 1809) was fought just outside the town of Talavera de la Reina, Spain some 120 kilometres (75 mi) southwest of Madrid, during the Peninsular War. At Talavera, a British army under Sir Arthur Wellesley combined with a Spanish army under General Gregorio García de la Cuesta fought in operations against French-occupied Madrid. At nightfall, the French army withdrew a short distance after several of its attacks had been repulsed; the allies, having suffered comparable casualties to the French, made no attempt to pursue.

Battle of Teruel.headline: Bitka pri Teruelu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Teruelu je med špansko državljansko vojno potekala v mestu Teruel in okolici med decembrom 1937 in februarjem 1938, v najhujši španski zimi v 20 letih. Bila je eden najbolj krvavih spopadov vojne: mesto je večkrat menjalo gospodarja, najprej so ga zavzeli republikanci, nazadnje pa so ga znova osvojili nacionalisti. Med boji je bil Teruel izpostavljen hudemu topniškemu in letalskemu obstreljevanju. V dvomesečni bitki sta obe strani skupaj utrpeli 110.000 žrtev.
Nacionalistični voditelj Francisco Franco je Teruel s premočjo v ljudeh in opremi znova osvojil. Bitka je postala vojaška prelomnica vojne.

source.title: Battle of Teruel
paragraphs: The Battle of Teruel was fought in and around the city of Teruel during the Spanish Civil War between December 1937 and February 1938, during the worst Spanish winter in 20 years. The battle was one of the bloodiest actions of the war, with the city changing hands several times by first falling to the Republicans and eventually being retaken by the Nationalists. In the course of the fighting, Teruel was subjected to heavy artillery and aerial bombardment. In the two-month battle, both factions together took 110,000 casualties.
With his superiority in men and material, the Nationalist leader Francisco Franco regained Teruel. This battle became the military turning point of the war.

Battle of Tewkesbury.headline: Bitka pri Tewkesburyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tewkesburyju (4. maja 1471) je bila ena najbolj odločilnih bitk vojne rož v Angliji.

Kralj Edvard IV. in njegove sile, zveste hiši York, so popolnoma porazile sile tekmovalne hiše Lancaster. Lancastrski prestolonaslednik Edvard Westminstrski, princ Walesa, in številni ugledni lancastrski plemiči so v bitki padli ali bili po njej usmrčeni. Lancastrski kralj Henrik VI., ki je bil ujetnik v londonskem Towru, je kmalu po bitki umrl, verjetno umorjen, čeprav je bil uradni vzrok smrti »velika otožnost«. Tewkesbury je Angliji vrnil politično stabilnost, ki je trajala do smrti Edvarda IV. leta 1483.

source.title: Battle of Tewkesbury
paragraphs: The Battle of Tewkesbury (4 May 1471) was one of the most decisive battles of the Wars of the Roses in England.

King Edward IV and his forces loyal to the House of York completely defeated those of the rival House of Lancaster. The Lancastrian heir to the throne, Edward of Westminster, Prince of Wales, and many prominent Lancastrian nobles were killed during the battle or executed after it. The Lancastrian king, Henry VI, who was a prisoner in the Tower of London, died shortly after the battle, likely murdered, although the official cause was stated as being of 'great melancholy'. Tewkesbury restored political stability to England until the death of Edward IV in 1483.

Battle of the Bogside.headline: Bitka za Bogside
paragraphs: Bitka za Bogside je bila velik tridnevni izgred, ki je od 12. do 14. avgusta 1969 potekal v Derryju na Severnem Irskem. Na tisoče katoliških oziroma irskih nacionalističnih prebivalcev četrti Bogside, organiziranih v Derryjskem društvu za obrambo državljanov, se je spopadlo s Kraljevo ulstrsko policijo (RUC) in lojalisti ter četrt zaprlo za oblasti. Bitka je sprožila razširjeno nasilje drugod po Severni Irski, privedla do napotitve britanskih vojakov in jo pogosto štejejo za začetek tridesetletnega spopada, znanega kot nemiri (The Troubles).

source.title: Battle of the Bogside
paragraphs: The Battle of the Bogside was a large three-day riot that took place from 12 to 14 August 1969 in Derry, Northern Ireland. Thousands of Catholic/Irish nationalist residents of the Bogside, organised under the Derry Citizens' Defence Association, clashed with the Royal Ulster Constabulary (RUC) and loyalists, and sealed off the neighbourhood to authorities. It sparked widespread violence elsewhere in Northern Ireland, led to the deployment of British troops, and is often seen as the beginning of the thirty-year conflict known as the Troubles.

Battle of the Burbia River.headline: Bitka ob reki Burbia
paragraphs: Bitka pri Río Burbia ali bitka ob reki Burbia je potekala leta 791 med enotami Kraljestva Asturija pod poveljstvom asturijskega kralja Bermuda I. in enotami Kordobskega emirata pod vodstvom Jusufa ibn Buhta. Bitka je potekala v okviru pohodov (gazv) Hišama I. proti Asturijcem na severu Iberskega polotoka. Odvila se je blizu reke Burbia na območju današnjega kraja Villafranca del Bierzo in se končala z zmago Kordobskega emirata.

source.title: Battle of the Burbia River
paragraphs: The Battle of Río Burbia or the Battle of the Burbia River was fought in the year 791 between the troops of the Kingdom of Asturias, commanded by King Bermudo I of Asturias, and the troops of the Emirate of Córdoba, led by Yusuf ibn Bukht. The battle occurred in the context of the Ghazws of Hisham I against the Asturians in the northern Iberian Peninsula. The battle took place near the Río Burbia, in the area which is today known as Villafranca del Bierzo. The battle resulted in a victory for the Emirate of Cordoba.

Battle of the Downs.headline: Bitka pri Downsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Downsu 21. oktobra 1639 je potekala v osemdesetletni vojni. Nizozemske sile pod Maartenom Trompom so premagale špansko ladjevje pod poveljstvom Antonia de Oquenda, zmaga pa je potrdila nizozemski nadzor nad Rokavskim prelivom in Severnim morjem.

Bitka se je začela, ko je španski prvi minister Olivares poslal velik konvoj enot in zalog za flandrijsko armado, ki ga je spremljalo okoli 50 vojnih ladij. Od leta 1621 se je španska pomorska dejavnost v Rokavskem prelivu osredotočala na izogibanje neposrednemu spopadu z močnejšim nizozemskim ladjevjem, medtem ko je iz kaperskih oporišč v Dunkerqueu in Ostendu napadala nizozemske trgovske ladje. Oquendo je v nasprotju s to politiko dobil ukaz, naj okrepitve dostavi, hkrati pa Nizozemce prisili v bitko; Olivares je upal, da bo zmaga znova uveljavila špansko pomorsko prevlado v severnoevropskih vodah, obnovila španski ugled in nizozemske generalne stanove prisilila v mirovna pogajanja.

source.title: Battle of the Downs
paragraphs: The Battle of the Downs, 21 October 1639, took place during the Eighty Years' War. A Spanish fleet commanded by Antonio de Oquendo was defeated by a Dutch force under Maarten Tromp, a victory that confirmed Dutch control of the English Channel and North Sea.

The battle was initiated when Spanish chief minister Olivares sent a large convoy of troops and supplies for the Army of Flanders, escorted by some 50 warships. Since 1621, Spanish naval activity in the Channel had focused on avoiding direct conflict with the superior Dutch fleet, while attacking their merchant ships from privateering bases in Dunkirk and Ostend. In a change from this policy, Oquendo was ordered to deliver the reinforcements but also bring the Dutch to battle; Olivares hoped victory would reassert Spanish naval dominance in northern European waters, restore Spanish prestige and force the Dutch States General to negotiate peace terms.

Battle of the Gabbard.headline: Bitka pri Gabbardu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gabbardu je bila pomorska bitka, ki je potekala od 2. do 3. junija 1653 v prvi angleško-nizozemski vojni. Odvila se je blizu plitvine Gabbard pred obalo Suffolka v Angliji med ladjevjema Angleške republike in Nizozemske republike in se končala s pomembno angleško zmago.

source.title: Battle of the Gabbard
paragraphs: The Battle of the Gabbard, was a naval battle fought from 2 to 3 June 1653 during the First Anglo-Dutch War. It took place near the Gabbard shoal off the coast of Suffolk, England, between fleets of the Commonwealth of England and the Dutch Republic. It resulted in a significant English victory.

Battle of the Gebora.headline: Bitka ob Gebori
paragraphs: Bitka ob Gebori je potekala v polotoški vojni med špansko in francosko vojsko 19. februarja 1811 severozahodno od Badajoza v Španiji. Številčno šibkejše francoske sile so pognale v beg in skoraj uničile špansko vojsko Extremadure.

Da bi pomagal rešiti vojsko maršala Andréja Massénaja iz zagate na Portugalskem – obtičala je pred lizbonskimi obrambnimi linijami Torres Vedras –, je maršal Jean de Dieu Soult del francoske Armée du Midi (Južne armade) iz Andaluzije povedel v sosednjo špansko pokrajino Extremaduro in oblegal pomembno utrjeno mesto Badajoz. Vikont Wellington in španski generalni kapitan Pedro Caro y Sureda, 3. markiz de La Romana, sta poslala špansko vojsko, da bi obleganje prekinila. La Romana pa je umrl, preden je vojska odšla, in poveljstvo je prevzel general Gabriel de Mendizábal Iraeta. Španci so ob podpori manjših portugalskih konjeniških sil prišli do mesta in se v začetku februarja 1811 utaborili na bližnjih višavah San Cristóbal.

source.title: Battle of the Gebora
paragraphs: The Battle of the Gebora took place during the Peninsular War between Spanish and French armies on 19 February 1811, northwest of Badajoz, Spain. An outnumbered French force routed and nearly destroyed the Spanish Army of Extremadura.

In a bid to help extricate Marshal André Masséna's army from its position in Portugal—mired in front of Lisbon's defensive Lines of Torres Vedras—Marshal Jean de Dieu Soult led part of the French Armée du Midi (Army of the South) from Andalusia into the neighbouring Spanish region of Extremadura and laid siege to the important fortress town of Badajoz. Viscount Wellington and the Spanish captain-general Pedro Caro y Sureda, 3rd Marquis de La Romana, sent a Spanish army to raise the siege. La Romana, however, died before the army could depart, and command fell to General Gabriel de Mendizábal Iraeta. Supported by a small force of Portuguese cavalry, the Spaniards reached the town and camped on the nearby heights of San Cristóbal in early February 1811.

Battle of the Medway.headline: Bitka ob reki Medway
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Medway je potekala leta 43 n. št., verjetno ob reki Medway na ozemlju železnodobnega plemena Kantiakov, danes angleške grofije Kent. Bila je ena zgodnjih bitk Klavdijevega vdora v Britanijo, ki ga je vodil Avl Plavcij.

source.title: Battle of the Medway
paragraphs: The Battle of the Medway took place in 43 AD, probably on the River Medway in the lands of the Iron Age tribe of the Cantiaci, now the English county of Kent. This was an early battle in the Claudian invasion of Britain, led by Aulus Plautius.

Battle of the Solent.headline: Bitka v Solentu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka v Solentu je potekala 18. in 19. julija 1545 v italijanskih vojnah med ladjevjema francoskega kralja Franca I. in angleškega kralja Henrika VIII. v ožini Solent med Hampshirom in otokom Wight. Bila je ena od le dveh pravih pomorskih bitk, v katerih se je bojevala tudorska mornarica kralja Henrika VIII., ob zgodnejši bitki pri Saint-Mathieuju.

Spopad se je končal brez zmagovalca, vendar so boji onemogočili francoske načrte za večjo invazijo na Anglijo in francosko ladjevje se je kmalu zatem umaknilo. Bitke se danes spominjajo predvsem po potopu angleške karake Mary Rose.

source.title: Battle of the Solent
paragraphs: The naval Battle of the Solent took place on 18 and 19 July 1545 during the Italian Wars, between the fleets of Francis I of France and Henry VIII of England, in the Solent, between Hampshire and the Isle of Wight. This was one of only two full-fledged naval battles fought by King Henry VIII's Tudor navy, along with the earlier Battle of Saint-Mathieu.

The engagement resulted in a standstill between both sides, but the French ambition to conduct a larger invasion of England had been rendered untenable by the fighting, and the French fleet withdrew shortly after. The battle is remembered today primarily for the sinking of the English carrack, Mary Rose.

Battle of the Standard.headline: Bitka pod praporom
paragraphs: Bitka pod praporom, včasih imenovana bitka pri Northallertonu, je potekala 22. avgusta 1138 na barju Cowton Moor blizu Northallertona v Yorkshiru v Angliji. Angleške sile pod Williamom iz Aumala so odbile škotsko vojsko pod vodstvom škotskega kralja Davida I.

Angleški kralj Štefan, ki se je na jugu bojeval z upornimi baroni, je poslal manjše sile (večinoma najemnike), angleško vojsko pa so sestavljali predvsem krajevna milica in spremstva baronov iz Yorkshira in severnega Midlandsa. Yorški nadškof Thurstan si je zelo prizadeval zbrati vojsko in pridigal, da je upreti se Škotom božje delo. Središče angleškega položaja je zato označeval jambor (nameščen na vozu) s piksido s posvečeno hostijo, na njem pa so plapolali posvečeni prapori cerkva v Yorku, Beverleyju in Riponu: od tod ime bitke. Ta prapor na vozu je bil zelo severen primer vrste prapora, ki je bila tedaj običajna v Italiji, kjer so ga imenovali carroccio.
Kralj David je v Anglijo vdrl iz dveh razglašenih razlogov.
notes: The English excerpt ends before it lists the two reasons; the Slovenian ends the sentence with a full stop.

source.title: Battle of the Standard
paragraphs: The Battle of the Standard, sometimes called the Battle of Northallerton, took place on 22 August 1138 on Cowton Moor near Northallerton in Yorkshire, England. English forces under William of Aumale repelled a Scottish army led by King David I of Scotland.

King Stephen of England, fighting rebel barons in the south, had sent a small force (largely mercenaries), but the English army was mainly local militia and baronial retinues from Yorkshire and the north Midlands. Archbishop Thurstan of York had exerted himself greatly to raise the army, preaching that to withstand the Scots was to do God's work. The centre of the English position was therefore marked by a mast (mounted upon a cart) bearing a pyx carrying the consecrated host and from which were flown the consecrated banners of the minsters of York, Beverley and Ripon: hence the name of the battle. This cart-mounted standard was a very northerly example of a type of standard common in contemporary Italy, where it was known as a carroccio.

Battle of the Upper Baetis.headline: Bitka ob gornjem Baetisu
paragraphs: Bitka ob gornjem Baetisu je bila dvojna bitka, sestavljena iz bitk pri Kastulu in Ilorki, ki je potekala leta 211 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni med kartažanskimi silami pod vodstvom Hasdrubala Barke (Hanibalovega brata) in rimskimi silami pod vodstvom Publija Kornelija Scipiona in njegovega brata Gneja. Neposredni izid je bila kartažanska zmaga, v kateri sta padla oba rimska brata. Pred tem porazom sta se brata sedem let (218–211 pr. n. št.) bojevala proti Kartažanom v Hispaniji in tako omejevala vire, ki so bili na voljo Hanibalu, ki se je hkrati bojeval z Rimljani v Italiji.

source.title: Battle of the Upper Baetis
paragraphs: The Battle of the Upper Baetis was a double battle, comprising the battles of Castulo and Ilorca, fought in 211 BC during the Second Punic War between a Carthaginian force led by Hasdrubal Barca (Hannibal's brother) and a Roman force led by Publius Cornelius Scipio and his brother Gnaeus. The immediate result was a Carthaginian victory in which both Roman brothers were killed. Before this defeat, the brothers had spent seven years (218–211 BC) campaigning against the Carthaginians in Hispania, thus limiting the resources available to Hannibal, who was simultaneously fighting the Romans in Italy.

Battle of the Winwaed.headline: Bitka ob Winwaedu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Winwaedu je potekala 15. novembra 655 med mercijskim kraljem Pendo in Oswiujem Bernicijskim in se končala s porazom Mercijcev in Pendovo smrtjo. Po Bedi je bitka dejansko pomenila konec anglosaškega poganstva.

source.title: Battle of the Winwaed
paragraphs: The Battle of the Winwaed was fought on 15 November 655 between King Penda of Mercia and Oswiu of Bernicia, ending in the Mercians' defeat and Penda's death. According to Bede, the battle marked the effective demise of Anglo-Saxon paganism.

Battle of Toro.headline: Bitka pri Toru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Toru je bila del vojne za kastiljsko nasledstvo; potekala je 1. marca 1476 blizu mesta Toro med kastiljsko-aragonskimi enotami katoliških vladarjev in portugalsko-kastiljskimi silami Afonsa V. in portugalskega princa Ivana.

Vojaško bitka ni bila odločena, saj sta obe strani razglasili zmago: sile pod princem Ivanom, ki so obdržale bojišče, so porazile kastiljsko desno krilo, enote Afonsa V. pa je premagalo kastiljsko levo središče pod vodstvom vojvode Albe in kardinala Mendoze.

Za katoliška vladarja pa je bila velika politična zmaga, saj je Izabeli zagotovila kastiljski prestol: preostali plemiči, zvesti Juani Trastamarski, so prestopili k Izabeli. Izabela je z veliko politično daljnovidnostjo izkoristila trenutek in sklicala »cortes« v Madrigalu in Segovii (april–oktober 1476). Tam so njeno hčer razglasili za dedinjo kastiljske krone, kar je pomenilo legitimacijo njenega lastnega prestola.

source.title: Battle of Toro
paragraphs: The Battle of Toro was part of the War of the Castilian Succession, fought on 1 March 1476, near the city of Toro, between the Castilian-Aragonese troops of the Catholic Monarchs and the Portuguese-Castilian forces of Afonso V and Prince John of Portugal.

The battle was militarily inconclusive, as both sides claimed victory: the Castilian right wing was defeated by the forces under Prince John who possessed the battlefield, but the troops of Afonso V were beaten by the Castilian left-centre led by the Duke of Alba and Cardinal Mendoza.

However, it was a major political victory for the Catholic Monarchs by assuring to Isabella the throne of Castile: The remnants of the nobles loyal to Juana de Trastámara adhered to Isabella. With great political vision, Isabella took advantage of the moment and summoned the 'Cortes' at Madrigal-Segovia (April–October 1476). There her daughter was proclaimed heiress of Castile's crown, which was equivalent to legitimising her own throne.

Battle of Towton.headline: Bitka pri Towtonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Towtonu je potekala 29. marca 1461 v vojni rož blizu Towtona v Severnem Yorkshiru. Yorške sile so odločilno porazile lancastrske privržence Henrika VI. in Edvardu IV. zagotovile angleški prestol. Bitka, v kateri se je na cvetno nedeljo v snežnem metežu deset ur bojevalo po ocenah 50.000 vojakov obeh strani, je bila »verjetno največja in najbolj krvava bitka na angleških tleh«.

Henrik VI. je očeta Henrika V. nasledil leta 1422, star devet mesecev, a je bil šibek, nesposoben in duševno neuravnovešen vladar, zato so plemiči spletkarili, da bi ga obvladovali. Razmere so se v 1450. letih sprevrgle v državljansko vojno med njegovimi sorodniki Beauforti in njegovo ženo, kraljico Margareto, na eni strani ter privrženci njegovega bratranca Riharda, vojvode Yorka, na drugi.

source.title: Battle of Towton
paragraphs: The Battle of Towton took place on 29 March 1461 during the Wars of the Roses, near Towton in North Yorkshire. Yorkist forces decisively defeated Lancastrian supporters of Henry VI, securing the English throne for Edward IV. Fought for ten hours between an estimated 50,000 soldiers from both sides in a snowstorm on Palm Sunday, it was "probably the largest and bloodiest battle on English soil".

Henry VI succeeded his father, Henry V, when he was nine months old in 1422, but was a weak, ineffectual and mentally unsound ruler, which encouraged the nobles to scheme for control over him. The situation deteriorated in the 1450s into a civil war between his Beaufort relatives and his wife, Queen Margaret, on one side, with those of his cousin Richard, Duke of York, on the other.

Bitka pri Trocaderu, ki je potekala 31. avgusta 1823, je bila pomembna bitka francoske odprave v podporo španskemu kralju Ferdinandu VII. Francozi so premagali španske liberalne sile in Ferdinandu vrnili absolutno oblast.

source.title: Battle of Trocadero
paragraphs: The Battle of Trocadero, fought on 31 August 1823, was a significant battle in France's expedition in support of the Spanish King Ferdinand VII. The French defeated the Spanish liberal forces and restored Ferdinand to absolute rule.

Battle of Tudela.headline: Bitka pri Tudeli
paragraphs: V bitki pri Tudeli (23. novembra 1808) je francoska cesarska vojska pod vodstvom maršala Jeana Lannesa napadla špansko vojsko pod generalom Castañosom. Bitka se je končala s popolno zmago cesarskih sil. Spopad se je odvil blizu Tudele v Navari v Španiji med polotoško vojno, delom širšega spopada, znanega kot napoleonske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Tudela
paragraphs: The Battle of Tudela (23 November 1808) saw an Imperial French army led by Marshal Jean Lannes attack a Spanish army under General Castaños. The battle resulted in the complete victory of the Imperial forces over their adversaries. The combat occurred near Tudela in Navarre, Spain during the Peninsular War, part of a wider conflict known as the Napoleonic Wars.

Battle of Uclés (1108).headline: Bitka pri Uclésu (1108)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Uclésu je potekala 29. maja 1108 v obdobju rekonkviste blizu Uclésa tik južno od reke Tajo med krščanskimi silami Kastilje in Leóna pod Alfonzom VI. in silami muslimanskih Almoravidov pod Tamimom ibn Jusufom. Bitka je bila za kristjane katastrofa: veliko visokih leonskih plemičev, med njimi sedem grofov, je padlo v boju ali so jim pozneje odsekali glave, prestolonaslednika Sanča Alfónseza pa so med begom umorili vaščani. Kljub temu Almoravidi uspeha na odprtem polju niso mogli izkoristiti za zavzetje Toleda.

source.title: Battle of Uclés (1108)
paragraphs: The Battle of Uclés was fought on 29 May 1108 during the Reconquista period near Uclés just south of the river Tagus between the Christian forces of Castile and León under Alfonso VI and the forces of the Muslim Almoravids under Tamim ibn-Yusuf. The battle was a disaster for the Christians and many of the high nobility of León, including seven counts, died in the fray or were beheaded afterwards, while the heir-apparent, Sancho Alfónsez, was murdered by villagers while trying to flee. Despite this, the Almoravids could not capitalise on their success in the open field by taking Toledo.

Bitka v zalivu Vigo, znana tudi kot bitka pri Randeju (galicijsko in špansko: Batalla de Rande) ali včasih kot bitka v zalivu Redondela, je bila pomorski spopad 23. oktobra 1702 v prvih letih vojne za špansko nasledstvo. Spopadu je predhodil angleško-nizozemski poskus, da bi septembra zavzeli špansko pristanišče Cádiz in si zagotovili pomorsko oporišče na Iberskem polotoku. Zavezniki so upali, da bodo iz tega oporišča vodili operacije v zahodnem Sredozemskem morju, zlasti proti Francozom v Toulonu.

Amfibijski napad pa se je končal s polomom, toda ko se je admiral George Rooke v začetku oktobra vračal domov, je izvedel, da je španska zakladna flota iz Amerike, natovorjena s srebrom in blagom, priplula v zaliv Vigo na severu Španije. Philips van Almonde je Rooka prepričal, naj napade zakladne ladje, čeprav je bilo leto že pozno in so ladje varovale francoske linijske ladje.

source.title: Battle of Vigo Bay
paragraphs: The Battle of Vigo Bay, also known as the Battle of Rande (Galician: Batalla de Rande; Spanish: Batalla de Rande) or sometimes as the Battle of Redondela Bay, was a naval engagement fought on 23 October 1702 during the opening years of the War of the Spanish Succession. The engagement followed an Anglo-Dutch attempt to capture the Spanish port of Cádiz in September in an effort to secure a naval base in the Iberian Peninsula. From this station the Allies had hoped to conduct operations in the western Mediterranean Sea, particularly against the French at Toulon.

The amphibious assault, however, had proved a disaster, but as Admiral George Rooke retreated home in early October, he received news that the Spanish treasure fleet from America, laden with silver and merchandise, had entered Vigo Bay in northern Spain. Philips van Almonde convinced Rooke to attack the treasure ships, despite the lateness of the year and the fact that the vessels were protected by French ships-of-the-line.

Pomorska bitka pri Vila Franca do Campo, znana tudi kot bitka pri Ponta Delgadi in pomorska bitka pri otoku Terceira, je potekala 26. julija 1582 pred obalo otoka São Miguel v portugalskem otočju Azori med vojno za portugalsko nasledstvo. Združena korzarska odprava, večinoma francoska (francosko in angleško ladjevje s portugalskimi silami), je odplula proti španskim pomorskim silam iz portugalskih in kastiljskih ladij, da bi ohranila Azore pod nadzorom pretendenta Antónia, priorja Crata, in otoke ubranila pred vključitvijo v Ibersko unijo; to so bile največje francoske sile, poslane čez morje pred dobo Ludvika XIV.

V prvem spopadu velikih ladjevij karak in galeon daleč od celine je eskadra pod Álvarom de Bazánom hudo porazila najemniško ladjevje pod Filippom di Piero Strozzijem. Španska zmaga je privedla do hitre španske osvojitve Azorov in dokončala vključitev Portugalske v Španski imperij.

source.title: Battle of Vila Franca do Campo
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Vila Franca do Campo, also known as Battle of Ponta Delgada and Naval Battle of Terceira Island, took place on 26 July 1582, off the coast of the island of São Miguel in the Portuguese archipelago of the Azores, during the War of the Portuguese Succession. A combined corsair expedition, mainly French (a French, and English fleet with Portuguese forces included), sailed against a Spanish naval force made up of Portuguese and Castilian ships, to preserve control of the Azores under the pretender António, Prior of Crato and to defend the islands from incorporation into the Iberian Union, the largest French force sent overseas before the age of Louis XIV.

In the first engagement between large fleets of carracks and galleons operating at great distances from the mainland, the mercenary fleet under Filippo di Piero Strozzi was severely defeated by a squadron under Álvaro de Bazán. The Spanish victory resulted in the rapid Spanish conquest of the Azores and completed the incorporation of Portugal into the Spanish Empire.

Battle of Villaviciosa.headline: Bitka pri Villaviciosi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Villaviciosi (11. decembra 1710) je bila bitka med francosko-špansko vojsko pod vodstvom Louisa Josepha, vojvode Vendômskega, in španskega kralja Filipa V. ter vojsko velike alianse pod poveljstvom avstrijskega generala Guida Starhemberga. Potekala je v vojni za špansko nasledstvo, dan po tem, ko je Vendômova vojska pri Brihuegi strla manjše britanske sile pod Jamesom Stanhopom. Zmago sta si pripisala tako španski kralj Filip V. kot nadvojvoda Karel Avstrijski, toda število mrtvih in ranjenih, število topov in drugega orožja, ki ga je zavezniška vojska pustila za sabo, ter strateške posledice bitke za vojno so potrdili Filipovo zmago.

Bitko so v veliki meri odločili španski dragonci pod poveljstvom markiza Valdecañasa in grofa Aguilarja, ki so daleč presegali nasprotne sile. Avstrijsko-zavezniške sile so se umaknile, zasledovala jih je španska konjenica, in ko je zavezniška vojska 6. januarja prispela v Barcelono (enega redkih krajev v Španiji, ki so še priznavali Karlovo oblast), je štela le še 6000 ali 7000 mož.

source.title: Battle of Villaviciosa
paragraphs: The Battle of Villaviciosa (11 December 1710) was a battle between a Franco-Spanish army led by Louis Joseph, Duke of Vendôme and Philip V of Spain and a Grand Alliance army commanded by Austrian General Guido Starhemberg. The battle took place during the War of the Spanish Succession, one day after a Vendôme's army overran a smaller British force under James Stanhope at Brihuega. Both Philip V of Spain and the Archduke Charles of Austria claimed victory, but the number of dead and wounded, the number of artillery and other weapons abandoned by the Allied army and the battle's strategic consequences for the war confirmed victory for Philip.

The battle was largely determined by the Spanish dragoons commanded by the Marquis of Valdecañas and the Count of Aguilar, which far exceeded the opposing forces. The Austro-allied forces retreated, pursued by Spanish cavalry, and the allied army was reduced to 6,000 or 7,000 men when it reached Barcelona (one of the few places in Spain still recognizing Charles' authority) on 6 January.

Battle of Vimeiro.headline: Bitka pri Vimeiru
paragraphs: V bitki pri Vimeiru (v tedanjih britanskih besedilih včasih zapisano »Vimiera« ali »Vimeira«) 21. avgusta 1808 so Britanci pod generalom Arthurjem Wellesleyjem (poznejšim vojvodo Wellingtonom) premagali Francoze pod generalmajorjem Jeanom-Andochom Junotom blizu vasi Vimeiro pri Lizboni na Portugalskem med polotoško vojno. Bitka je končala prvo francosko invazijo na Portugalsko.
notes: The Portuguese pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Vimeiro
paragraphs: In the Battle of Vimeiro (sometimes shown as "Vimiera" or "Vimeira" in contemporary British texts) on 21 August 1808, the British under General Arthur Wellesley (who later became the Duke of Wellington) defeated the French under Major-General Jean-Andoche Junot near the village of Vimeiro (Portuguese pronunciation: [viˈmɐjɾu]), near Lisbon, Portugal, during the Peninsular War. This battle put an end to the first French invasion of Portugal.

V bitki pri Vitorii (21. junija 1813) je britanska, portugalska in španska vojska pod markizom Wellingtonom blizu Vitorie v Španiji strla francosko vojsko pod kraljem Jožefom Bonapartejem in maršalom Jeanom-Baptistom Jourdanom, kar je nazadnje privedlo do zmage v polotoški vojni.

source.title: Battle of Vitoria
paragraphs: At the Battle of Vitoria (21 June 1813), a British, Portuguese and Spanish army under the Marquess of Wellington broke the French army under King Joseph Bonaparte and Marshal Jean-Baptiste Jourdan near Vitoria in Spain, eventually leading to victory in the Peninsular War.

Battle of Wakefield.headline: Bitka pri Wakefieldu
paragraphs: »Bitka« pri Wakefieldu naj bi po izročilu potekala 30. decembra 1460 v Sandal Magni blizu Wakefielda na severu Anglije. Novejše raziskave kažejo, da ni šlo za bitko v pravem pomenu besede, temveč za manjšo prasko, v kateri so bili ujeti in so nato umrli Rihard Yorški, 3. vojvoda York, njegov drugi sin Edmund, grof Rutland, in Richard Neville, 5. grof Salisbury.

source.title: Battle of Wakefield
paragraphs: The 'Battle' of Wakefield has traditionally been said to have taken place in Sandal Magna near Wakefield in northern England, on 30 December 1460. Recent research demonstrates that it was not a battle in the proper sense of a word, but a small-scale skirmish that resulted in the capture and subsequent deaths of Richard of York, 3rd Duke of York, his second son, Edmund, Earl of Rutland, and Richard Neville, 5th Earl of Salisbury.

Battle of Winchelsea.headline: Bitka pri Winchelseaju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Winchelseaju ali bitka Les Espagnols sur Mer (»Španci na morju«) je bila pomorska bitka 29. avgusta 1350 v stoletni vojni med Anglijo in Francijo. Angleško ladjevje s 50 ladjami pod poveljstvom kralja Edvarda III. je v njej premagalo kastiljsko ladjevje s 47 večjimi ladjami pod poveljstvom Charlesa de la Cerde. Angleži so zajeli med 14 in 26 kastiljskih ladij, več so jih potopili. Znano je, da sta bili potopljeni le dve angleški ladji, vendar je umrlo veliko ljudi.

Angleška trgovina, financiranje vojne in zmožnost bojevanja proti Franciji so bili močno odvisni od pomorskega prevoza, zlasti na angleško ozemlje v Gaskonji. Ker so angleške akcije močno zmanjšale lastno zmožnost Francozov, da zberejo in vzdržujejo ladjevje, so ti najeli kastiljske ladje, da bi blokirale angleška pristanišča. Edvard III., razočaran nad njihovo učinkovitostjo, je vodil ladjevje, ki jih je prestreglo in jim prizadejalo hude izgube. Kljub temu uspehu so francosko ladjevje in njegovi zavezniki angleško trgovino in pristanišča še naprej nadlegovali skoraj nezmanjšano.

source.title: Battle of Winchelsea
paragraphs: The Battle of Winchelsea or the Battle of Les Espagnols sur Mer ("the Spaniards on the Sea") was a naval battle that took place on 29 August 1350 as part of the Hundred Years' War between England and France. It was a victory for an English fleet of 50 ships, commanded by King Edward III, over a Castilian fleet of 47 larger vessels, commanded by Charles de la Cerda. Between 14 and 26 Castilian ships were captured, and several were sunk. Only two English vessels are known to have been sunk, but there was a significant loss of life.

England's trade, its war finance and its ability to bring force to bear against France were heavily reliant on seaborne transportation, especially to its territory in Gascony. With their own ability to raise and support a fleet much reduced by English activities, the French hired Castilian ships to blockade English ports. Frustrated by their effectiveness, Edward III led the fleet that intercepted them and inflicted heavy losses. In spite of that success, English trade and ports saw little relief from naval harassment by the French and their allies.

Battle of Worcester.headline: Bitka pri Worcestru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Worcestru je potekala 3. septembra 1651 v mestu Worcester v Angliji in okolici in je bila zadnja velika bitka vojn treh kraljestev v letih 1642–1651. Parlamentarna vojska s približno 28.000 možmi pod Oliverjem Cromwellom je premagala pretežno škotske rojalistične sile s 16.000 možmi pod vodstvom Karla II., kralja Anglije in Škotske.

Rojalisti so zavzeli obrambne položaje v Worcestru in okolici. Bojišče je delila reka Severn, reka Teme pa je bila dodatna ovira jugozahodno od Worcestra. Cromwell je vojsko razdelil na dva glavna dela, ločena s Severnom, da bi napadel z vzhoda in jugozahoda. Pri rečnih prehodih so potekali hudi boji, dva nevarna izpada rojalistov proti vzhodnim parlamentarnim silam pa so odbili. Ko so parlamentarci naskočili veliko reduto vzhodno od mesta, so vstopili v Worcester in organizirani odpor rojalistov je propadel. Karel II. se je izognil ujetju.

source.title: Battle of Worcester
paragraphs: The Battle of Worcester took place on 3 September 1651 in and around the city of Worcester, England and was the last major battle of the 1642 to 1651 Wars of the Three Kingdoms. A Parliamentarian army of around 28,000 under Oliver Cromwell defeated a largely Scottish Royalist force of 16,000 led by Charles II of England and Scotland.

The Royalists took up defensive positions in and around the city of Worcester. The area of the battle was bisected by the River Severn, with the River Teme forming an additional obstacle to the south-west of Worcester. Cromwell divided his army into two main sections, divided by the Severn, in order to attack from both the east and south-west. There was fierce fighting at river crossing points and two dangerous sorties by the Royalists against the eastern Parliamentary force were beaten back. Following the storming of a major redoubt to the east of the city, the Parliamentarians entered Worcester and organised Royalist resistance collapsed. Charles II was able to escape capture.

Battles of El Bruch.headline: Bitki pri El Brucu
paragraphs: Bitki pri El Brucu (špansko: Batallas del Bruch; katalonsko: Batalles del Bruc) sta bili spopada, ki sta si sledila 6. in 14. junija 1808 pri El Brucu blizu Barcelone v Kataloniji med polotoško vojno; francoske enote pod poveljstvom brigadnega generala Françoisa de Schwarza in divizijskega generala Josepha Chabrana so se bojevale proti španskim prostovoljcem in najemnikom pod vodstvom generala Antonija Francha i Estalelle in Joana Bageta.
Izid teh bitk in spopadov je bila španska zmaga.

source.title: Battles of El Bruch
paragraphs: The two battles of the Bruch (Spanish: Batallas del Bruch; Catalan: Batalles del Bruc) were engagements fought successively, at El Bruc, near Barcelona, Catalonia, on 6 and 14 June 1808, during the Peninsular War, by French troops commanded by Brigadier General François de Schwarz and General of Division Joseph Chabran against Spanish volunteers and mercenaries led by General Antoni Franch i Estalella and Joan Baget.
The result of these battles and actions was a Spanish victory.
Berga je glavno mesto comarce (okraja) Berguedà v provinci Barcelona v Kataloniji v Španiji. Meji na občine Cercs, Olvan, Avià, Capolat in Castellar del Riu.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is a state, but its link points to the article on the modern town; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Berga
paragraphs: Berga (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈbeɾɣə]) is the capital of the comarca (county) of Berguedà, in the province of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It is bordered by the municipalities of Cercs, Olvan, Avià, Capolat and Castellar del Riu.

Bernicia.headline: Bernicija
paragraphs: Bernicija (staroangleško: Bernica rice, Beornica rice) je bila anglosaško kraljestvo, ki so ga v 6. stoletju ustanovili anglski naseljenci na območju današnje jugovzhodne Škotske in severovzhodne Anglije.

Anglsko ozemlje Bernicije je približno ustrezalo današnjim angleškim grofijam Northumberland, Tyne and Wear in Durham ter škotskima grofijama Berwickshire in East Lothian in je segalo od reke Forth do reke Tees. V začetku 7. stoletja se je Bernicija združila z južno sosedo Deiro v kraljestvo Northumbrija, njene meje pa so se nato precej razširile.

source.title: Bernicia
paragraphs: Bernicia (Old English: Bernica rice, Beornica rice) was an Anglo-Saxon kingdom established by Anglian settlers of the 6th century in what is now southeastern Scotland and North East England.

The Anglian territory of Bernicia was approximately equivalent to the modern English counties of Northumberland, Tyne and Wear, and Durham, as well as the Scottish counties of Berwickshire and East Lothian, stretching from the Forth to the Tees. In the early 7th century, it merged with its southern neighbour, Deira, to form the kingdom of Northumbria, and its borders subsequently expanded considerably.

Vojne škofov so bile dve vojni, ki sta v letih 1639 in 1640 potekali med Karlom I. in njegovimi nasprotniki covenanterji na Škotskem. Z njimi so se začele vojne treh kraljestev, ki vključujejo tudi prvo in drugo angleško državljansko vojno, irske konfederacijske vojne in angleško-škotsko vojno v letih 1650–1652.

Leta 1637 je Karel I., tedaj kralj Škotske in Anglije, škotski Cerkvi vsilil spremembe verske prakse. Številni Škoti so jih zamerili, zato so leta 1638 podpisali narodno zavezo (National Covenant), s katero so se zavezali, da bodo preprečili njihovo uveljavitev. Generalna skupščina škotske Cerkve je nato izgnala škofe, s čimer se je verski spor sprevrgel v boj za politično prevlado. Nova covenanterska vlada je zbrala vojsko, da bi Karlu preprečila, da bi s silo obnovil svojo oblast.

source.title: Bishops' Wars
paragraphs: The Bishops' Wars were two wars fought in 1639 and 1640 between Charles I and his Covenanter opponents in Scotland. They were the first of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms, which also include the First and Second English Civil Wars, the Irish Confederate Wars, and the 1650 to 1652 Anglo-Scottish War.

In 1637, Charles I, then king of Scotland and England, imposed changes in religious practice on the Church of Scotland. These were resented by many Scots, leading to the signing of a National Covenant in 1638, pledging to prevent their implementation. The General Assembly of the Church of Scotland then expelled bishops, turning a religious dispute into a struggle for political supremacy. The new Covenanter government raised an army to prevent Charles using force to restore his authority.

Bowring Treaty.headline: Bowringova pogodba
paragraphs: Pogodba o prijateljstvu in trgovini med Veliko Britanijo in Siamom (tajsko: หนังสือสัญญากรุงเทพมหานครกับกรุงอังกริษเปนทางไมตรีค้าขายกัน), pogovorno znana kot Bowringova pogodba, je bila zgodovinska prelomna pogodba, ki sta jo 18. aprila 1855 v Thonburiju v Bangkoku podpisala Združeno kraljestvo v času vladavine kraljice Viktorije in Kraljevina Siam v času vladavine kralja Mongkuta. Pogodba je močno vplivala na siamsko gospodarstvo, družbo in mednarodne odnose v tajski zgodovini; v večini zgodovinopisja pomeni začetek »modernega Siama«, hkrati pa je bila vzor za neenakopravne pogodbe »bowringovskega tipa«, ki jih je Siam v 19. stoletju sklepal z drugimi zahodnimi državami.

source.title: Bowring Treaty
paragraphs: Treaty of Friendship and Commerce between Great Britain and Siam (Thai: หนังสือสัญญากรุงเทพมหานครกับกรุงอังกริษเปนทางไมตรีค้าขายกัน), known colloquially as the Bowring Treaty, was the historic landmark treaty signed between the United Kingdom during the reign of Queen Victoria and the Kingdom of Siam during the reign of King Mongkut on 18 April 1855 at Thonburi, Bangkok. The treaty had tremendous effects on Siamese economy, society and international relations in Thai history, marking the advent of "Modern Siam" in most historiographies, also serving as the model for "Bowring-type" unequal treaties that Siam was going to make with other Western nations in the nineteenth century.

Brycheiniog.headline: Brycheiniog
paragraphs: Brycheiniog je bil neodvisno kraljestvo v južnem Walesu v zgodnjem srednjem veku. Pogosto je bil tamponska država med Anglijo na vzhodu in južnovaližanskim kraljestvom Deheubarth na zahodu. Normani so ga med letoma 1088 in 1095 osvojili in pomirili, a je ohranil valižanski značaj. Preoblikovali so ga v gospostvo Brecknock, pozneje pa je tvoril južni in večji del zgodovinske grofije Brecknockshire. Južno od njega je ležalo kraljestvo Morgannwg.

Glavna dediščina kraljestva Brycheiniog je etimološka in geografska. Ime se ohranja v Bannau Brycheiniog, valižanskem imenu gorovja Brecon Beacons, od leta 2023 pa tudi v imenu narodnega parka v tem gorovju. Iz njega izhajata tudi poangleščeni imeni Brecknockshire (v valižanščini ohranjeno kot Sir Frycheiniog, »grofija Brycheiniog«) in Brecon (v valižanščini tudi Aberhonddu).

source.title: Brycheiniog
paragraphs: Brycheiniog was an independent kingdom in South Wales in the Early Middle Ages. It often acted as a buffer state between England to the east and the south Welsh kingdom of Deheubarth to the west. It was conquered and pacified by the Normans between 1088 and 1095, though it remained Welsh in character. It was transformed into the Lordship of Brecknock and later formed the southern and larger part of the historic county of Brecknockshire. To its south was the Kingdom of Morgannwg.

The main legacy of the kingdom of Brycheiniog is etymological and geographical. It is used in Bannau Brycheiniog, the Welsh name for the Brecon Beacons range and, since 2023, in name used for the range's national park. Its name is also the origin to the anglicised names Brecknockshire (retained in Welsh as Sir Frycheiniog, 'the shire of Brycheiniog'), and Brecon (otherwise known as Aberhonddu in Welsh).

Burney Treaty.headline: Burneyjeva pogodba
paragraphs: Pogodbo med Kraljevino Siam in Veliko Britanijo, splošno znano kot Burneyjeva pogodba, sta 20. junija 1826 v Bangkoku podpisala Henry Burney, zastopnik britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe, v imenu Britanije in kralj Rama III. v imenu Siama. Sledila je zgodnejši pogodbi s 24. februarja 1826, s katero je Siam postal zaveznik Britanije proti dinastiji Konbaung (Burmi), s katero je bila Britanija v vojni. Siamska vojska je bila zbrana in opremljena, a v vojni ni resneje sodelovala zaradi zamer in nezaupanja, ki jih je povzročil siamski vdor v Kedah leta 1821.

source.title: Burney Treaty
paragraphs: The treaty between Kingdom of Siam and Great Britain commonly known as the Burney Treaty was signed at Bangkok on 20 June 1826 by Henry Burney, an agent of British East India Company, for Britain, and King Rama III for Siam. It followed an earlier treaty of 24 February 1826, in which Siam became an ally of Britain against the Konbaung Dynasty (Burma) with which Britain was at war. A Siamese army was raised and equipped but took no serious part in the war because of ill feeling and suspicion arising from the Siamese invasion of Kedah in 1821.
Kantonalna revolucija (špansko: Revolución cantonal) je bila poskus, da bi leta 1873 v Španiji ustanovili revolucionarno republiko, ki bi temeljila na decentraliziranem sistemu kantonov.

Po slavni revoluciji leta 1868 je Španija zašla v politično nestabilnost, ki je dosegla vrhunec z ustanovitvijo prve španske republike. Zvezna demokratična republikanska stranka (PRDF) pod vodstvom Francesca Pija i Margalla je bila izvoljena, da bi državo preuredila v zvezno republiko, vendar so notranje delitve v stranki privedle do novih sporov. Levičarski »nepopustljivi« republikanci so se zavzemali, da bi zvezno republiko oblikovali od spodaj navzgor, ne pa z ustavo od zgoraj navzdol, kot jo je predlagala vlada Pija i Margalla.

source.title: Cantonal Rebellion
paragraphs: The Cantonal Revolution (Spanish: Revolución cantonal) was an attempt to establish a revolutionary republic, based on a decentralised system of cantons, in Spain in 1873.

Following the Glorious Revolution of 1868, Spain was thrown into political instability which culminated in the establishment of the First Spanish Republic. The Federal Democratic Republican Party (PRDF), led by Francesc Pi i Margall, was elected to reconstitute the country as a federal republic, but internal divisions within the party led to further conflict. Left-wing "intransigent" republicans advocated for the formation of the federal republic from the bottom-up, rather than the top-down constitution proposed by the Pi i Margall government.

Nageljnova revolucija (portugalsko: Revolução dos Cravos), s kodnim imenom operacija Zgodovinski preobrat, znana tudi kot 25. april in portugalska revolucija (portugalsko: Revolução Portuguesa), je bila vojaški udar častnikov na Portugalskem, ki je 25. aprila 1974 strmoglavil Marcela Caetana in režim Estado Novo, ki ga je vzpostavil António de Oliveira Salazar (vladal 1932–1968). Udar se je zgodil sredi portugalske kolonialne vojne (1961–1974) v čezmorskih kolonijah in prek tako imenovanega tekočega revolucionarnega procesa povzročil velike družbene, gospodarske, ozemeljske, demografske in politične spremembe na Portugalskem ter v Angoli, Gvineji Bissau, Mozambiku in drugih nekdanjih portugalskih kolonijah. Pripeljal je do portugalskega prehoda v demokracijo in konca portugalske kolonialne vojne. Imel je tudi svetovne posledice, saj je pomenil začetek tretjega vala demokratizacije.

source.title: Carnation Revolution
paragraphs: The Carnation Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução dos Cravos), code-named Operation Historic Turn, also known as the 25 April, and Portuguese Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução Portuguesa) was a military coup in Portugal by officers that on 25 April 1974 overthrew Marcelo Caetano and the Estado Novo regime established by António de Oliveira Salazar (r. 1932–1968). The coup came in the midst of the Portuguese Colonial War (1961–1974) in its overseas colonies and produced major social, economic, territorial, demographic, and political changes in Portugal and in Angola, Guinea-Bissau, Mozambique, and other former Portuguese colonies through the Ongoing Revolutionary Process. It resulted in the Portuguese transition to democracy and an end to the Portuguese Colonial War. It also had worldwide repercussions by marking the beginning of the third wave of democracy.

Angleška republika (Commonwealth of England), ki se je leta 1653 razširila v Republiko Anglijo, Škotsko in Irsko, je bila politična ureditev v obdobju 1649–1660, ko je bilo Kraljestvo Anglija po koncu druge angleške državljanske vojne ter sojenju in usmrtitvi Karla I. razpuščeno in spremenjeno v republiko. Obstoj republike je razglasil zakon »An Act declaring England to be a Commonwealth« (Zakon o razglasitvi Anglije za republiko), ki ga je okrnjeni parlament (Rump Parliament) sprejel 19. maja 1649. Oblast v zgodnji republiki sta imela predvsem parlament in državni svet. V tem času so se nadaljevali boji med parlamentarnimi silami in njihovimi nasprotniki, zlasti na Irskem in Škotskem: Cromwellova osvojitev Irske in angleško-škotska vojna v letih 1650–1652.

source.title: Commonwealth of England
paragraphs: The Commonwealth of England, enlarged in 1653 as the Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland, was the political structure during the period from 1649 to 1660 when the Kingdom of England was dissolved into a republic after the end of the Second English Civil War and the trial and execution of Charles I. The republic's existence was declared through "An Act declaring England to be a Commonwealth", adopted by the Rump Parliament on 19 May 1649. Power in the early Commonwealth was vested primarily in the Parliament and a Council of State. During the period, fighting continued, particularly in Ireland and Scotland, between the parliamentary forces and those opposed to them, in the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland and the Anglo-Scottish war of 1650–1652.

Irska konfederacija, imenovana tudi Irska katoliška konfederacija, je bila obdobje irske katoliške samouprave med letoma 1642 in 1652, med enajstletno vojno. Ustanovili so jo katoliški aristokrati, zemljiško plemstvo, duhovščina in vojaški voditelji po irskem uporu leta 1641; konfederati so s sedežem v Kilkennyju nadzorovali do dve tretjini Irske, zato jo včasih imenujejo tudi konfederacija iz Kilkennyja.

source.title: Confederate Ireland
paragraphs: Confederate Ireland, also referred to as the Irish Catholic Confederation, was a period of Irish Catholic self-government between 1642 and 1652, during the Eleven Years' War. Formed by Catholic aristocrats, landed gentry, clergy and military leaders after the Irish Rebellion of 1641, the Confederates controlled up to two-thirds of Ireland from their base in Kilkenny; hence it is sometimes called the Confederation of Kilkenny.

Grofija Aragonija (aragonsko: Condato d'Aragón) ali grofija Jaca (aragonsko: Condato de Chaca) je bila majhna frankovska mejna grofija v osrednji pirenejski dolini reke Aragón, ki je obsegala Ansó, Echo in Canfranc s središčem v mestecu Jaca (latinsko Iacca, aragonsko Chaca), na območju današnje Španije. Ustanovili so jo Karolingi konec 8. ali v začetku 9. stoletja, a je kmalu prišla pod vpliv navarskega kraljestva, ki mu je bila leta 922 priključena. Pozneje je postala jedro aragonskega kraljestva v 11. stoletju.

source.title: County of Aragon
paragraphs: The County of Aragon (Aragonese: Condato d'Aragón) or County of Jaca (Aragonese: Condato de Chaca) was a small Frankish marcher county in the central Pyrenean valley of the Aragon river, comprising Ansó, Echo, and Canfranc and centered on the small town of Jaca (Iacca in Latin and Chaca in Aragonese), an area now part of Spain. It was created by the Carolingians late in the 8th or early in the 9th century, but soon fell into the orbit of the Kingdom of Navarre, into which it was absorbed in 922. It would later form the core of the 11th century Kingdom of Aragon.

County of Besalú.headline: Grofija Besalú
paragraphs: Grofija Besalú (katalonsko: Comtat de Besalú; latinsko: Comitatus Bisuldunensis) je bila ena od srednjeveških katalonskih grofij brez dostopa do morja blizu sredozemske obale. Približno se je ujemala z današnjo comarco Garrotxa, občasno pa je segala vse do Corbièresa v departmaju Aude, danes v Franciji. Glavni kraj je bila vas Besalú. Večino zgodovine je bila priključena kateri od drugih, močnejših grofij, stoletje pa je bila neodvisna, preden so jo dokončno in nepreklicno priključili barcelonski grofiji.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Besalú
paragraphs: The County of Besalú (Catalan: Comtat de Besalú, IPA: [kumˈtad də βəzəˈlu]; Latin: Comitatus Bisuldunensis) was one of the landlocked medieval Catalan counties near the Mediterranean coastline. It was roughly coterminous with the modern comarca of Garrotxa and at various times extended as far north as Corbières, Aude, now in France. Its capital was the village of Besalú. Throughout most of its history it was attached to one of the other more powerful counties, but it experienced a century of independence before it was finally and irrevocably annexed to the County of Barcelona.

Grofija Empúries (katalonsko: Comtat d'Empúries), znana tudi kot grofija Ampurias (špansko: Condado de Ampurias), je bila srednjeveška grofija s središčem v mestu Empúries, ki je obsegala katalonsko pokrajino Peralada. Ustreza zgodovinski comarci Empordà.

Ko so Franki leta 785 osvojili te pokrajine, sta Empúries in Peralada prišli pod oblast grofije Girona. Okoli leta 813 je Empúries skupaj s Peralado postala samostojna grofija pod Ermenguerjem. Ta in drugi zgodnji grofje so bili verjetno vizigotskega rodu. Leta 817 so Empúries združili z grofijo Roussillon, zveza pa je trajala do leta 989. Eden od grofov Empúriesa v 9. stoletju je zbral dovolj močno ladjevje, da je osvojil Balearske otoke, a le za kratek čas. Od leta 835 do 844 je Empúriesu in Peraladi vladal Sunyer I., Roussillonu in Vallespirju pa Alarik I.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Empúries
paragraphs: The County of Empúries (Catalan: Comtat d'Empúries, IPA: [kumˈtad dəmˈpuɾiəs]), also known as the County of Ampurias (Spanish: Condado de Ampurias), was a medieval county centred on the town of Empúries and enclosing the Catalan region of Peralada. It corresponds to the historic comarca of Empordà.

After the Franks conquered the regions in 785, Empúries and Peralada came under the authority of the County of Girona. Around 813, Empúries, with Peralada, became a separate county under Ermenguer. He and the other early counts were probably of Visigothic origin. In 817, Empúries was merged with the County of Roussillon, a union which lasted until 989. One of the ninth-century counts of Empúries assembled a fleet powerful enough to conquer the Balearic Islands, but only for a brief time. From 835 to 844, Sunyer I ruled Empúries and Peralada while Alaric I ruled Roussillon and Vallespir.

County of Osona.headline: Grofija Osona
paragraphs: Grofija Osona ali Ausona (katalonsko: Comtat d'Osona; latinsko: Comitatus Ausonae) je bila ena od katalonskih grofij Hispanske marke v zgodnjem in visokem srednjem veku. Središče je imela v glavnem mestu Vic (Vicus) in pripadajoči škofiji, katere ozemlje je približno ustrezalo današnji comarci Osona.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Osona
