paragraphs: The County of Osona, also Ausona (Catalan: Comtat d'Osona, IPA: [kumˈtad duˈzonə]; Latin: Comitatus Ausonae), was one of the Catalan counties of the Marca Hispanica in the Early and High Middle Ages. It was based around the capital city of Vic (Vicus) and the corresponding diocese, whose territory was roughly the current comarca of Osona.

County of Pallars.headline: Grofija Pallars
paragraphs: Grofija Pallars ali Pallás (katalonsko: Comtat de Pallars; latinsko: Comitatus Pallariensis) je bila v 9. in 10. stoletju dejansko neodvisna majhna država, formalno v Karolinškem cesarstvu in nato v Zahodni Frankovski, morda ena od katalonskih grofij, ki je bila sprva v 9. stoletju del Hispanske marke. Obsegala je zgornjo dolino reke Noguera Pallaresa od grebena Pirenejev do vasi Tremp, z dolinami Vall d'Àneu, Vall de Cardós in Vall Ferrera, desnim bregom reke Noguera Ribagorçana in dolino reke Flamicell. Približno je ustrezala zgodovinski katalonski pokrajini Pallars. Glavno mesto je bil Sort.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Pallars
paragraphs: The County of Pallars or Pallás (Catalan: Comtat de Pallars, IPA: [kumˈtad də pəˈʎas]; Latin: Comitatus Pallariensis) was a de facto independent petty state, nominally within the Carolingian Empire and then West Francia during the ninth and tenth centuries, perhaps one of the Catalan counties, originally part of the Marca Hispanica in the ninth century. It was coterminous with the upper Noguera Pallaresa valley from the crest of the Pyrenees to the village of Tremp, comprising the Vall d'Àneu, Vall de Cardós, Vall Ferrera, the right bank of the Noguera Ribagorçana, and the valley of the Flamicell. It roughly corresponded with the historic region of Catalonia called Pallars. Its chief city was Sort.

County of Ribagorza.headline: Grofija Ribagorza
paragraphs: Grofija Ribagorza ali Ribagorça (aragonsko: Condato de Ribagorza; katalonsko: Comtat de Ribagorça; latinsko: Comitatus Ripacurtiae) je bila srednjeveška grofija na južni strani Pirenejev, ki je obsegala severovzhod današnje Aragonije in del severozahoda današnje Katalonije, obe v Španiji. Sprva jo je samostojno ustanovila krajevna dinastija, pozneje pa je bila vključena v navarsko kraljestvo in nato v Aragonsko krono. Tesno zgodovinsko je bila povezana s sosednjima grofijama Sobrarbe (na zahodu) in Pallars (na vzhodu). Njeno ozemlje so sestavljale doline rek Ésera, Isábena in Noguera Ribagorzana. Sedež grofov je bil v Benabarreju, med drugimi pomembnimi kraji so Benasque, Graus in Pont de Suert. Zahodni del grofije danes približno ustreza aragonski comarci Ribagorza s središčem v Grausu, vzhodni pa katalonski comarci Alta Ribagorça.

source.title: County of Ribagorza
paragraphs: The County of Ribagorza or Ribagorça (Aragonese: Condato de Ribagorza; Catalan: Comtat de Ribagorça; Latin: Comitatus Ripacurtiae) was a medieval county on the southern side of the Pyrenees, including the northeast of modern Aragón and part of the northwest of modern Catalonia, both in Spain. It was originally the independent creation of a local dynasty, later absorbed into the Kingdom of Navarre and then into the Crown of Aragon. It had a strong historical connection with the neighboring counties of Sobrarbe (to the west) and Pallars (to the east). Its territory consisted of the valleys of the rivers Ésera, Isábena, and Noguera Ribagorzana. The seat of its counts was at Benabarre. Other notable towns include Benasque, Graus and Pont de Suert. Today the western portion of the county roughly corresponds to the Aragonese comarca of Ribagorza, with its administrative centre in Graus; the eastern portion roughly corresponds to the Catalan comarca of Alta Ribagorça.
Grofija Urgell (katalonsko: Comtat d'Urgell; latinsko: Comitatus Urgellensis) je ena od zgodovinskih katalonskih grofij, ki je mejila na grofiji Pallars in Cerdanya.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Urgell
paragraphs: The County of Urgell (Catalan: Comtat d'Urgell, IPA: [komˈtad duɾˈdʒeʎ]; Latin: Comitatus Urgellensis) is one of the historical Catalan counties, bordering on the counties of Pallars and Cerdanya.

Dál Riata.headline: Dál Riata
paragraphs: Dál Riata ali Dál Riada (tudi Dalriada) je bila gelsko kraljestvo na zahodni obali Škotske in severovzhodu Irske, na obeh straneh Severnega preliva. Na vrhuncu v 6. in 7. stoletju je obsegala današnji Argyll (»obala Gelov«) na Škotskem in del grofije Antrim na Severnem Irskem. Po obdobju širitve se je Dál Riata sčasoma povezala z gelskim kraljestvom Alba.

source.title: Dál Riata
paragraphs: Dál Riata or Dál Riada (also Dalriada) was a Gaelic kingdom that encompassed the western seaboard of Scotland and northeastern Ireland, on each side of the North Channel. At its height in the 6th and 7th centuries, it covered what is now Argyll ("Coast of the Gaels") in Scotland and part of County Antrim in Northern Ireland. After a period of expansion, Dál Riata eventually became associated with the Gaelic Kingdom of Alba.

Danish attacks on Norman England.headline: Danski napadi na normansko Anglijo
paragraphs: Danci so normansko Anglijo napadli dvakrat. Prvič so v letih 1069–1070 vdrli v zavezništvu z različnimi angleškimi uporniki in zavzeli najprej York in nato Ely, nazadnje pa so sprejeli podkupnino in zapustili državo. Drugič je šlo za obsežen roparski pohod leta 1075 v podporo uporu grofov, med katerim so opustošili obalo Lincolnshira in York. Tretji napad je bil načrtovan leta 1085: zbrali so veliko invazijsko ladjevje danskih, flamskih in norveških ladij, ki pa ni nikoli izplulo. Vse tri napade je spodbudila zahteva po angleškem prestolu, ki jo je prvi uveljavljal danski kralj Sven II. (vladal 1047–1076), nečak Knuta Velikega, poznejši danski kralji pa so jo vzdrževali vse do 13. stoletja. Toda nobeden od obeh uresničenih napadov ni Svenove zahteve uveljavil niti Dancem ni prinesel ničesar razen nekaj plena.

source.title: Danish attacks on Norman England
paragraphs: There were two Danish attacks on Norman England. The first was an invasion in 1069–1070 conducted in alliance with various English rebels which succeeded in taking first York and then Ely before the Danes finally accepted a bribe to leave the country. The second was a large-scale raid in 1075, intended to support the Revolt of the Earls, in which the Lincolnshire coast and York were both ravaged. A third attack was planned in 1085, and a large invasion fleet composed of Danish, Flemish, and Norwegian vessels was assembled which never sailed. All three attacks were motivated by a claim on the English throne asserted originally by Cnut the Great's nephew Sweyn II, king of Denmark (r. 1047–1076), and maintained by later Danish kings until as late as the 13th century, but neither of the two realised attacks succeeded in making Sweyn's claim good, or indeed gained anything for the Danes apart from a certain amount of plunder.
Deira (starovaližansko/kumbrijsko: Deywr ali Deifr; staroangleško: Dere ali Dera rice) je bila območje v porimski Britaniji in pozneje anglsko kraljestvo.
notes: The English pronunciation guide is dropped.

source.title: Deira
paragraphs: Deira ( DY-rə, DAIR-ə; Old Welsh/Cumbric: Deywr or Deifr; Old English: Dere or Dera rice) was an area of Post-Roman Britain, and a later Anglian kingdom.

Danska - Norveška je bila večnarodna in večjezična realna unija od 16. do 19. stoletja, ki so jo sestavljali Kraljevina Danska, Kraljevina Norveška (s tedanjimi norveškimi čezmorskimi posestmi: Ferskimi otoki, Islandijo, Grenlandijo in drugimi), Vojvodina Schleswig in Vojvodina Holstein. Država je zahtevala suverenost tudi nad tremi zgodovinskimi ljudstvi: Frizijci, Guti in Vendi. Imela je več kolonij, in sicer Dansko Zlato obalo, Dansko Indijo (Nikobarske otoke, Serampore, Tharangambadi) in Dansko Zahodno Indijo.

Prebivalci države so bili predvsem Danci, Norvežani in Nemci, v norveških čezmorskih posestih pa tudi Ferci, Islandci in Inuiti, na severu Norveške samijska manjšina ter druga domorodna ljudstva. Glavna mesta Danske - Norveške so bila København, Christiania (Oslo), Altona, Bergen in Trondhjem, glavna uradna jezika sta bila danščina in nemščina, krajevno pa so govorili tudi norveško, islandsko, fersko, samijsko in grenlandsko.

source.title: Denmark–Norway
paragraphs: Denmark–Norway was a 16th-to-19th-century multi-national and multi-lingual real union consisting of the Kingdom of Denmark, the Kingdom of Norway (including the then Norwegian overseas possessions: the Faroe Islands, Iceland, Greenland, and other possessions), the Duchy of Schleswig, and the Duchy of Holstein. The state also claimed sovereignty over three historical peoples: Frisians, Gutes and Wends. Denmark–Norway had several colonies, namely the Danish Gold Coast, Danish India (the Nicobar Islands, Serampore, Tharangambadi), and the Danish West Indies.

The state's inhabitants were mainly Danes, Norwegians and Germans, and also included Faroese, Icelanders and Inuit in the Norwegian overseas possessions, a Sami minority in northern Norway, as well as other indigenous peoples. The main cities of Denmark–Norway were Copenhagen, Christiania (Oslo), Altona, Bergen and Trondhjem, and the primary official languages were Danish and German, but Norwegian, Icelandic, Faroese, Sami and Greenlandic were also spoken locally.

Vojvodina Gaskonja ali vojvodina Vaskonija je bila vojvodina na jugozahodu današnje Francije in severovzhodu Španije, na območju današnje pokrajine Gaskonja. Vojvodina, tedaj znana kot Vaskonija, je bila sprva frankovska marka, ustanovljena za obvladovanje Baskov. Doživela je različna obdobja, od zgodnjih let z izrazito baskovsko prvino prek personalne unije z Vojvodino Akvitanijo do poznejšega obdobja, ko je bila odvisno ozemlje angleških kraljev iz rodbine Plantagenet.

Gaskonja je bila približno 300 let, od leta 1152 do 1453, neprekinjeno pod angleško oblastjo. Francoski kralj Karel VII. je ozemlje znova osvojil kot zadnje dejanje stoletne vojne, Kraljevina Francija pa si je severni del ozemlja priključila leta 1453. Ustrezni del na Iberskem polotoku je postal Kraljestvo Navara.

source.title: Duchy of Gascony
paragraphs: The Duchy of Gascony or Duchy of Vasconia was a duchy located in present-day southwestern France and northeastern Spain, an area encompassing the modern region of Gascony. The Duchy of Gascony, then known as Vasconia, was originally a Frankish march formed to hold sway over the Basques. However, the duchy went through different periods, from its early years with its distinctively Basque element to the merger in personal union with the Duchy of Aquitaine to the later period as a dependency of the Plantagenet kings of England.

Gascony was under continuous English rule for approximately 300 years, from 1152 to 1453. Charles VII of France reconquered the territory as a final act of the Hundred Years' War and the northern part of the territory was annexed by the Kingdom of France in 1453. The corresponding portion within the Iberian Peninsula became the Kingdom of Navarre.

Dumnonija (starogrško: Δαμνόνιον, Damnónion, v pridevniški obliki), polatinjeno ime, je bila britonsko kraljestvo, ki je med 6. in 7. stoletjem n. št. obstajalo v porimski Britaniji, v zahodnejših delih današnje jugozahodne Anglije.

Predhodno predrimsko ozemlje Dumnonijcev je imelo središče na območju današnjega Devona, obsegalo pa je tudi današnji Cornwall in del Somerseta; njegova vzhodna meja se je sčasoma pomikala proti zahodu, ko se je postopoma širilo sosednje anglosaško kraljestvo Wessex. Včasih se pojavlja tudi zapis Damnonia, ki pa označuje tudi deželo Damnonijcev, pozneje del Kraljestva Strathclyde na jugu današnje Škotske.
Pojavlja se tudi oblika Domnonia. Ime kraljestva je jezikovno sorodno z imenom bretonske pokrajine Domnonée (bretonsko: Domnonea).

source.title: Dumnonia
paragraphs: Dumnonia (Ancient Greek: Δαμνόνιον, romanized: Damnónion, in the adjective form), a Latinised name, was a Brythonic kingdom that existed in Sub-Roman Britain between the 6th century CE and the 7th century CE in the more westerly parts of present-day South West England.

Its predecessor, the pre-Roman Dumnonii territory, was centred in the area of modern Devon, but also included modern Cornwall and part of Somerset; its eastern boundary was moved westward over time with the gradual expansion of the neighbouring Anglo-Saxon kingdom of Wessex. The spelling Damnonia is sometimes encountered, but that spelling is also used for the land of the Damnonii, later part of the Kingdom of Strathclyde, in present-day southern Scotland.
The form Domnonia also occurs. The name of the kingdom shares a linguistic relationship with the Breton region of Domnonée (Breton: Domnonea).

Dunoding.headline: Dunoding
paragraphs: Dunoding je bil zgodnje podkraljestvo v Kraljestvu Gwynedd na severozahodu Walesa, ki je obstajalo med 5. in 10. stoletjem. Po izročilu je dobil ime po Dunodu, ki je okoli leta 460 z območja pregnal irske naseljence; Dunod je bil sin Cunedde Wlediga, ustanovitelja Gwynedda. Ozemlje je kot podrejeno kraljestvo v Gwyneddu obstajalo, dokler okoli leta 925 ni izumrla rodbina vladarjev, ki so izhajali od Dunoda. Po koncu Dunodove rodbine so ga razdelili na kantrefa Eifionydd in Ardudwy ter ga v celoti priključili Gwyneddu. Ko je bilo kraljestvo Gwynedd leta 1283 poraženo in priključeno Angliji, sta kantrefa postala dela grofij Caernarfonshire oziroma Merionethshire. Danes je ozemlje del sodobne grofije Gwynedd.

source.title: Dunoding
paragraphs: Dunoding was an early sub-kingdom within the Kingdom of Gwynedd in north-west Wales which existed between the 5th and 10th centuries. According to tradition, it was named after Dunod, a son of the founding father of Gwynedd – Cunedda Wledig – who drove the Irish settlers from the area in c. 460. The territory existed as a subordinate realm within Gwynedd until the line of rulers descended from Dunod expired in c. 925. Following the end of the House of Dunod, it was split into the cantrefi of Eifionydd and Ardudwy and fully incorporated into Gwynedd. After the defeat of the kingdom of Gwynedd in 1283 and its annexation to England, the two cantrefi became parts of the counties of Caernarfonshire and Merionethshire, respectively. It is now part of the modern county of Gwynedd.

Earl of Desmond.headline: Grof Desmond
paragraphs: Grof Desmond (irsko: Iarla Dheasumhan, kar pomeni »grof južnega Munstra«) je plemiški naslov, ki ga je angleški monarh ustvaril v irskem plemstvu. Naslov je bil podeljen štirikrat. Prvič ga je leta 1329 dobil Maurice FitzGerald, 4. baron Desmond, hibernsko-normanski gospod na jugozahodu Irske, njegovi potomci pa so ga imeli do leta 1583, ko so se v desmondskih uporih uprli angleški kroni. Po dveh kratkotrajnih ponovnih podelitvah v začetku 17. stoletja ima naslov od leta 1628 rodbina Feilding iz Warwickshira v Angliji. Sedanji nosilec je Alexander Feilding, 12. grof Denbigh in 11. grof Desmond (4. podelitev). Grofija rodbine Fitzgerald je zgodovinsko obsegala vso današnjo grofijo Limerick ter velike dele grofij Cork, Kerry in Waterford. Mejila je na kraljestvi Desmond in Thomond ter na grofijo Ormond.
notes: The record is the earldom as a state; the article is about the title. "The early 1600s" is given as the beginning of the 17th century.

source.title: Earl of Desmond
paragraphs: Earl of Desmond (Irish: Iarla Dheasumhan meaning Earl of South Munster) is a title of nobility created by the English monarch in the peerage of Ireland. The title has been created four times. It was first awarded in 1329 to Maurice FitzGerald, 4th Baron Desmond, a Hiberno-Norman lord in Southwest Ireland, and it was held by his descendants until 1583 when they rose against the English crown in the Desmond Rebellions. Following two short-lived recreations of the title in the early 1600s, the title has been held since 1628 by the Feilding family of Warwickshire, England. The current holder is Alexander Feilding, 12th Earl of Denbigh and 11th Earl of Desmond (4th creation). The earldom held by the Fitzgerald family historically comprised what is now the entirety of County Limerick with large swathes of County Cork, County Kerry and County Waterford also being included. It bordered the Kingdom of Desmond, Kingdom of Thomond and the Earldom of Ormond

Habsburška Španija, znana tudi kot katoliška monarhija, je bila obdobje španske zgodovine in Španskega imperija od leta 1516 do 1700, ko so vladali kralji iz habsburške dinastije. Španski imperij je bil tedaj na vrhuncu moči in vpliva. Španija je imela številna ozemlja, med drugim celinske posesti v Ameriki in Zahodno Indijo; evropska ozemlja, kot so Nizke dežele, italijanska ozemlja, Portugalska in deli Francije; ter Filipine in druge posesti v jugovzhodni Aziji. To obdobje španske zgodovine imenujejo tudi »doba širitve«.

Člani rodbine imena Habsburg niso vedno uporabljali, pogosto so poudarjali svoje uglednejše kneževske naslove. Dinastija je bila dolgo znana kot »avstrijska hiša«. Poimenovanje tega obdobja kot »habsburškega« je do neke mere pripomoček zgodovinarjev.

source.title: Habsburg Spain
paragraphs: Habsburg Spain, also known as the Catholic Monarchy, was the period of Spanish history and Spanish Empire from 1516 to 1700 when it was ruled by kings from the House of Habsburg. In this period the Spanish Empire was at the zenith of its power and influence. During this period, Spain held many territories, including Pan-American continental holdings and the West Indies; European territories like the Low Countries, Italian territories, Portugal and parts of France; and the Philippines and other possessions in Southeast Asia. The period of Spanish history has also been referred to as the "Age of Expansion".

The Habsburg name was not always used by the family members, who often emphasized their more prestigious princely titles. The dynasty was long known as the "House of Austria". Calling this era "Habsburg", is, to some extent, a convenience for historians.

Hwicce.headline: Hwicce
paragraphs: Hwicce je bilo kraljestvo v anglosaški Angliji. Po Anglosaški kroniki je bilo ustanovljeno leta 577, po bitki pri Deorhamu. Po letu 628 je zaradi bitke pri Cirencestru postalo odvisno kraljestvo ali podkraljestvo Mercie.
V popisu Tribal Hidage je bilo Hwicce ocenjeno na 7000 hid, kar ustreza kmetijskemu gospodarstvu kraljestva Essex ali Sussex.

Natančne meje kraljestva niso znane, verjetno pa so se ujemale z mejami stare škofije Worcester, ustanovljene v letih 679–680, katere zgodnji škofje so nosili naslov Episcopus Hwicciorum. Kraljestvo bi torej obsegalo Worcestershire brez severozahodnega roba, Gloucestershire brez gozda Dean, jugozahodno polovico Warwickshira, okolico Batha severno od reke Avon, del zahodnega Oxfordshira ter majhne dele Herefordshira, Shropshira, Staffordshira in severozahodnega Wiltshira.
notes: The Old English pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Hwicce
paragraphs: Hwicce (Old English: [ˈʍittʃe]) was a kingdom in Anglo-Saxon England. According to the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, the kingdom was established in 577, after the Battle of Deorham. After 628, the kingdom became a client or sub-kingdom of Mercia as a result of the Battle of Cirencester.
The Tribal Hidage assessed Hwicce at 7,000 hides, an agricultural economy akin to either the kingdom of Essex or Sussex.

The exact boundaries of the kingdom remain uncertain, though it is likely that they coincided with those of the old Diocese of Worcester, founded in 679–680, the early bishops of which bore the title Episcopus Hwicciorum. The kingdom would therefore have included Worcestershire except the northwestern tip, Gloucestershire except the Forest of Dean, the southwestern half of Warwickshire, the neighbourhood of Bath north of the Avon, part of west Oxfordshire and small parts of Herefordshire, Shropshire, Staffordshire and north-west Wiltshire.

Irska svobodna država (6. decembra 1922 – 29. decembra 1937), znana tudi z irskim imenom Saorstát Éireann, je bila irska država, ustanovljena decembra 1922 na podlagi angleško-irske pogodbe iz decembra 1921, sprva kot dominion. Pogodba je končala triletno irsko osamosvojitveno vojno med silami Irske republike, Irsko republikansko armado (IRA), in silami britanske krone.

source.title: Irish Free State
paragraphs: The Irish Free State (6 December 1922 – 29 December 1937), also known by its Irish name Saorstát Éireann, was the Irish state established in December 1922 under the Anglo-Irish Treaty of December 1921, initially as a Dominion. The treaty ended the three-year Irish War of Independence between the forces of the Irish Republic—the Irish Republican Army (IRA)—and British Crown forces.

Kingdom of Alba.headline: Kraljestvo Alba
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Alba (latinsko: Scotia; škotsko gelsko: Alba) je bilo ime Kraljevine Škotske v obdobju od smrti Donalda II. leta 900 do smrti Aleksandra III. leta 1286. Aleksandrova smrt je posredno pripeljala do vdora angleškega kralja Edvarda I. na Škotsko leta 1296 in do prve škotske osamosvojitvene vojne.

Alba je vključevala Dalriado, sprva pa ni obsegala velikih delov današnjega Škotskega nižavja, ki sta si ga tedaj vse do zaliva Firth of Forth na severu delila Strathclyde in Northumbrija. Piktsko kraljestvo Fortriu na severu je bilo Albi priključeno v 10. stoletju.
Do začetka 13. stoletja Moraya niso šteli za del Albe, za katero so menili, da sega le od zaliva Firth of Forth do reke Spey.

source.title: Kingdom of Alba
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Alba (Latin: Scotia; Scottish Gaelic: Alba) was the Kingdom of Scotland between the deaths of Donald II in 900 and of Alexander III in 1286. The latter's death led indirectly to an invasion of Scotland by Edward I of England in 1296 and the First War of Scottish Independence.

Alba included Dalriada, but initially excluded large parts of the present-day Scottish Lowlands, which were then divided between Strathclyde and Northumbria as far north as the Firth of Forth. Fortriu, a Pictish kingdom in the north, was added to Alba in the tenth century.
Until the early 13th century, Moray was not considered part of Alba, which was seen as extending only between the Firth of Forth and the River Spey.

Kraljestvo Kastilija je bilo srednjeveška država na Iberskem polotoku. Izvira iz grofije Kastilija iz 9. stoletja, vzhodnega obmejnega gospostva Kraljestva León. Kastiljski grofje so v 10. stoletju povečali svojo samostojnost, a šele leta 1065 se je Kastilija ločila od Kraljestva León in postala samostojno kraljestvo. Med letoma 1072 in 1157 je bila znova združena z Leónom, po letu 1230 pa je zveza postala trajna.

V tem obdobju so kastiljski kralji na jugu Iberskega polotoka na račun islamskih kneževin veliko osvojili. Kraljestvi Kastilija in León s svojimi južnimi pridobitvami sta postali znani kot Kastiljska krona, izraz, ki je pozneje zajemal tudi čezmorsko širitev.

source.title: Kingdom of Castile
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Castile was a polity in the Iberian Peninsula during the Middle Ages. It traces its origins to the 9th-century County of Castile, as an eastern frontier lordship of the Kingdom of León. During the 10th century, the Castilian counts increased their autonomy, but it was not until 1065 that it was separated from the Kingdom of León and became a kingdom in its own right. Between 1072 and 1157, it was again united with León, and after 1230, the union became permanent.

Throughout that period, the Castilian kings made extensive conquests in southern Iberia at the expense of the Islamic principalities. The Kingdoms of Castile and of León, with their southern acquisitions, came to be known collectively as the Crown of Castile, a term that also came to encompass overseas expansion.

Kraljestvo Vzhodnih Anglov (staroangleško: Ēastengla Rīċe; latinsko: Regnum Orientalium Anglorum), neuradno znano kot Kraljestvo Vzhodna Anglija ali Vzhodna Anglija, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo Anglov v anglosaškem obdobju, ki je obstajalo od 6. stoletja do leta 918 n. št. Obsegalo je ozemlje današnjih angleških grofij Norfolk in Suffolk ter morda vzhodni del Fens; območje se še danes imenuje Vzhodna Anglija.

Kraljestvo, ki je nastalo v 6. stoletju po anglosaški naselitvi Britanije, je bilo eno od kraljestev heptarhije. V 7. in 8. stoletju je vladala rodbina Wuffingas, leta 794 pa je ozemlje zavzel mercijski kralj Offa. Po Offovi smrti je mercijska oblast za kratek čas popustila, nato pa so jo znova vzpostavili. Danska velika poganska vojska se je leta 865 izkrcala v Vzhodni Angliji; po zavzetju Yorka se je vrnila, leta 869 ubila kralja Edmunda (»Mučenca«) in deželo spremenila v dansko. Ko je Alfred Veliki Dancem vsilil pogodbo, je Vzhodna Anglija ostala del danskega prava (Danelaw).
notes: The English pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of East Anglia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the East Angles (/ˈæŋ.ɡli.ə/; Old English: Ēastengla Rīċe; Latin: Regnum Orientalium Anglorum), informally known as the Kingdom of East Anglia or East Anglia, was an early medieval English kingdom of the Angles during the Anglo-Saxon period, existing from the 6th century to 918 CE. It comprised the territory which now constitutes the English counties of Norfolk and Suffolk and perhaps the eastern part of the Fens; the area is still known as East Anglia.

The kingdom formed in the 6th century in the wake of the Anglo-Saxon settlement of Britain was one of the kingdoms of the Heptarchy. It was ruled by the Wuffingas dynasty in the 7th and 8th centuries, but the territory was taken by Offa of Mercia in 794. Mercian control lapsed briefly following the death of Offa but was re-established. The Danish Great Heathen Army landed in East Anglia in 865; after taking York it returned to East Anglia, killing King Edmund ("the Martyr") and making it Danish land in 869. After Alfred the Great forced a treaty with the Danes, East Anglia was left as part of the Danelaw.

Kraljestvo Vzhodnih Sasov, imenovano Kraljestvo Essex, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo, eno od sedmih tradicionalnih kraljestev anglosaškega obdobja. Ustanovljeno je bilo v 6. stoletju in je obsegalo ozemlje poznejših grofij Essex in Middlesex, velikega dela Hertfordshira in (za kratek čas) zahodnega Kenta. Zadnji kralj Essexa je bil Sigered, ki je leta 825 kraljestvo prepustil wessexškemu kralju Ecgberhtu.

source.title: Kingdom of Essex
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the East Saxons, referred to as the Kingdom of Essex, was an early medieval English kingdom, constituting one of the seven traditional kingdoms of the Anglo-Saxon period. It was founded in the 6th century and covered the territory later occupied by the counties of Essex, Middlesex, much of Hertfordshire and (for a short while) west Kent. The last king of Essex was Sigered of Essex, who in 825 ceded the kingdom to Ecgberht, King of Wessex.

Kraljestvo Galicija je bilo politična tvorba v jugozahodni Evropi, ki je na vrhuncu ozemeljskega obsega zavzemala ves severozahod Iberskega polotoka. Nastalo je v začetku 10. stoletja z razdelitvijo Kraljestva Asturija po smrti Alfonza III. leta 910: njegovi sinovi so si kraljestvo razdelili in Galicijo je podedoval Ordoño II. Galicija je postala samostojna politična tvorba, a je z leonskim in asturijskim kraljestvom ostala tesno povezana z dinastičnimi vezmi. Ordoño II. jo je pozneje, ko je podedoval León, vključil v Kraljestvo León. Kraljestvo Galicija je bilo občasno napol neodvisno, navadno pa so ga imeli za del Kraljestva León. Santiago de Compostela je postal prestolnica Galicije v 11. stoletju, neodvisnost Portugalske (1128) pa je določila njeno južno mejo. Ko je kastiljski kralj Ferdinand III. leta 1230 nasledil leonski prestol, je Galicija prišla pod nadzor Kastiljske krone.

source.title: Kingdom of Galicia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Galicia was a political entity located in southwestern Europe, which, at its territorial zenith, occupied the entire northwest of the Iberian Peninsula. In the early 10th century, the Kingdom of Galicia was formed following the division of the Kingdom of Asturias after the death of Alfonso III in 910. His sons split the kingdom, with Ordoño II inheriting Galicia. While Galicia became a distinct political entity, it remained closely tied to the Leonese and Asturian realms through dynastic connections. Later, Ordoño II integrated Galicia into the Kingdom of León when he inherited the latter. Though the Kingdom of Galicia had moments of semi-independence, it was typically seen as part of the Kingdom of León. Santiago de Compostela became the capital of Galicia in the 11th century, while the independence of Portugal (1128) determined its southern boundary. The accession of Castilian King Ferdinand III to the Leonese kingdom in 1230 brought Galicia under the control of the Crown of Castile.

Gwent (starovaližansko: Guent) je bil srednjeveško valižansko kraljestvo med rekama Wye in Usk. Obstajal je od konca rimske oblasti v Britaniji okoli 5. stoletja do normanske invazije na Wales v 11. stoletju. Skupaj s sosednjim Glywysingom je imel očitno veliko kulturne kontinuitete s starejšimi Siluri: kraljestvi sta ohranili svoje dvore in škofijo, ločeno od preostalega Walesa, dokler ju ni osvojil Gruffydd ap Llywelyn. Čeprav je po njegovi smrti leta 1063 znova postal neodvisen, je bil Gwent prvo valižansko kraljestvo, ki so ga po normanski osvojitvi pregazili.

source.title: Kingdom of Gwent
paragraphs: Gwent (Old Welsh: Guent) was a medieval Welsh kingdom, lying between the Rivers Wye and Usk. It existed from the end of Roman rule in Britain in about the 5th century until the Norman invasion of Wales in the 11th century. Along with its neighbour Glywysing, it seems to have had a great deal of cultural continuity with the earlier Silures, keeping their own courts and diocese separate from the rest of Wales until their conquest by Gruffydd ap Llywelyn. Although it recovered its independence after his death in 1063, Gwent was the first of the Welsh kingdoms to be overrun following the Norman conquest.

Kraljestvo Gwynedd je bilo valižansko kraljestvo, ki se je prvič pojavilo na prelomu 6. stoletja. Vladarji Gwynedda s središčem na severozahodu Walesa so se večkrat povzpeli do prevlade in bili razglašeni za »kralja Britov«, nato pa so oblast izgubili v državljanskih vojnah ali invazijah. Kraljestvo Gruffudda ap Llywelyna, kralja Walesa od leta 1055 do 1063, je leta 1063, tik pred normansko invazijo na Wales, razbila saška invazija. Rodbina Aberffraw, ki jo je obnovil Gruffudd ap Cynan, si je počasi opomogla, in Llywelyn Veliki iz Gwynedda je leta 1216 na zboru valižanskih knezov v Aberdyfiju razglasil Kneževino Wales. Pogodba iz Aberconwyja med angleškim kraljem Edvardom I. in Llywelynovim vnukom Llywelynom ap Gruffuddom je leta 1277 prinesla mir, hkrati pa je zagotovila, da se bo valižanska samouprava z Llywelynovo smrtjo končala, zato je pomenila konec prve faze Edvardove osvojitve Walesa.

source.title: Kingdom of Gwynedd
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Gwynedd was a Welsh kingdom which first appeared at the turn of the sixth century. Based in northwest Wales, the rulers of Gwynedd repeatedly rose to dominance and were acclaimed as "King of the Britons" before losing their power in civil wars or invasions. The kingdom of Gruffudd ap Llywelyn—the King of Wales from 1055 to 1063—was shattered by a Saxon invasion in 1063 just prior to the Norman invasion of Wales, but the House of Aberffraw restored by Gruffudd ap Cynan slowly recovered and Llywelyn the Great of Gwynedd was able to proclaim the Principality of Wales at the Aberdyfi gathering of Welsh princes in 1216. In 1277, the Treaty of Aberconwy between Edward I of England and Llywelyn's grandson Llywelyn ap Gruffudd granted peace between the two but would also guarantee that Welsh self-rule would end upon Llywelyn's death, and so it represented the completion of the first stage of the conquest of Wales by Edward I.

Kraljestvo Kentčanov, danes imenovano Kraljestvo Kent, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo na območju današnje jugovzhodne Anglije. Obstajalo je od 5. ali 6. stoletja n. št., dokler ga sredi 9. stoletja ni v celoti vsrkalo Kraljestvo Wessex, v začetku 10. stoletja pa Kraljestvo Anglija.

source.title: Kingdom of Kent
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the Kentish, today referred to as the Kingdom of Kent, was an early medieval English kingdom in present-day South East England. It existed from either the fifth or the sixth century AD until it was fully absorbed into the Kingdom of Wessex in the mid-9th century and later into the Kingdom of England in the early 10th century.

Kraljestvo León je bilo srednjeveška država na severozahodu Iberskega polotoka. Ustanovljeno je bilo leta 910, ko so krščanski knezi Asturije ob severni obali polotoka prestolnico preselili iz Ovieda v mesto León. Leonski kralji so se v nemirnem času bojevali v državljanskih vojnah, vojnah s sosednjimi kraljestvi ter proti vpadom Mavrov in Vikingov, da bi ohranili svoje kraljestvo.

source.title: Kingdom of León
paragraphs: The Kingdom of León was a medieval state situated in the northwest region of the Iberian Peninsula. It was founded in 910, when the Christian princes of Asturias along the northern coast of the peninsula shifted their capital from Oviedo to the city of León. The kings of León fought civil wars, wars against neighbouring kingdoms, and invasions by the Moors and the Vikings, to sustain their kingdom through a turbulent age.

Kingdom of Lindsey.headline: Kraljestvo Lindsey
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Lindsey (staroangleško: Lindesege) je bilo manjše anglosaško kraljestvo na območju današnjega severnega Lincolnshira v 6. in 7. stoletju, morda pa je obstajalo še v začetku 8. stoletja. Ime Lindsey izhaja iz staroangleškega toponima Lindesege, »otok Lind«. Rimljani so naselje, ki je danes mesto Lincoln v Lincolnshiru, imenovali Lindum Colonia. (V stari angleščini se je Lindum Colonia skrajšalo v Lindocolina in nato v Lincylene.) Lindum je polatinjena oblika domačega britonskega imena, ki so ga rekonstruirali kot *Lindon (dobesedno »tolmun« ali »jezero«; prim. sodobno valižansko llyn).

source.title: Kingdom of Lindsey
paragraphs: The Lindsey (Old English: Lindesege) was a lesser Anglo-Saxon kingdom in what is now north Lincolnshire in the sixth and seventh centuries, possibly extending into the early eighth century. The name Lindsey derives from the Old English toponym Lindesege, meaning "Isle of Lind". Lindum Colonia was the Roman name of the settlement which is now the City of Lincoln in Lincolnshire. (Lindum Colonia was shortened in Old English to Lindocolina and then Lincylene.) Lindum was a Latinised form of a native Brittonic name which has been reconstructed as *Lindon (lit. 'pool' or 'lake'; cf. modern Welsh llyn).

Kraljestvo Majorka je bilo otoško kraljestvo ob vzhodni obali današnje Španije, ki je obsegalo otoke Majorka, Minorka, Ibiza in Formentera. Otoke je Almohadskemu kalifatu odvzel aragonski kralj Jakob I. in jih vključil v Aragonsko krono. Zaradi osvojitve Majorke je dobil vzdevek Jakob Osvajalec.

Jakob I. je ob smrti leta 1276 svoja ozemlja razdelil med tri preživele sinove. Najstarejši, Peter, je očeta nasledil na celini kot aragonski kralj Peter III. ali Peter Veliki. Kraljestvo Majorka je prešlo na mlajšega sina Jakoba, ki je vladal kot Jakob II. Majorški.

Peter III. Aragonski je po letu 1279 odredil, da mora biti majorški kralj vazal aragonskega kralja, kar je seveda pripeljalo do spora med bratoma. Nazadnje je leta 1344 Kraljestvo Majorko zasedel aragonski kralj Peter IV. in ga priključil Aragonski kroni. Ostalo je ločeno kraljestvo, a z istim kraljem, dokler ga leta 1715 niso odpravili dekreti Nueva Planta.

source.title: Kingdom of Majorca
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Majorca was an insular realm off the east coast of modern day Spain, which included the islands of Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza and Formentera. The islands were conquered from the Almohad Caliphate by James I of Aragon, and were integrated in the Crown of Aragon. The king became known as James the Conqueror due to the Conquest of Majorca.

When James I died in 1276, he divided his territories between his three surviving sons. Peter, the eldest, succeeded his father in the mainland as Peter III of Aragon or Peter the Great. The Kingdom of Majorca passed to the younger son James, who reigned as James II of Majorca.

After 1279, Peter III of Aragon decreed that the King of Majorca was to be a vassal of the King of Aragon. Naturally, this led to conflict between the two brothers. Finally, in 1344, the Kingdom of Mallorca was invaded by King Peter IV of Aragon and brought under the Crown of Aragon. It remained a separate Kingdom, but with the same King, until its dissolution in 1715 by the Nueva Planta decrees.

Kingdom of Morgannwg.headline: Kraljestvo Morgannwg
paragraphs: Morgannwg (danes Glamorgan) je bil kraljestvo na jugovzhodu Walesa. Tako so konec 10. stoletja začeli imenovati Kraljestvo Glywysing, ki je propadlo, ko so ga okoli leta 1091 osvojili Normani.

source.title: Kingdom of Morgannwg
paragraphs: Morgannwg (now Glamorgan) was a kingdom in south-east Wales. It was a name for the Kingdom of Glywysing which came into use at the end of the tenth century and ended with conquest by the Normans around 1091.

Kraljestvo Powys (latinsko: Regnum Poysiae) je bilo valižanska država naslednica, majhno kraljestvo in kneževina, ki je nastalo v srednjem veku po koncu rimske oblasti v Britaniji. Zelo približno je obsegalo severni dve tretjini današnje grofije Powys in del današnjega angleškega West Midlandsa. Natančneje, njegove meje so temeljile na rimsko-britanskih plemenskih ozemljih Ordovikov na zahodu in Kornovijev na vzhodu ter so sprva segale od Kambrijskega gorovja na zahodu do današnje angleške regije West Midlands na vzhodu. Tam ležita rodovitni dolini rek Severn in Tern, to območje pa poznejša valižanska književnost imenuje »raj Powysa« (vzdevek, ki se je v valižanščini ohranil za današnjo britansko grofijo).
notes: The Welsh pronunciation in IPA and the reference to a map are dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of Powys
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Powys (Welsh pronunciation: [ˈpowɪs]; Latin: Regnum Poysiae) was a Welsh successor state, petty kingdom and principality that emerged during the Middle Ages following the end of Roman rule in Britain. It very roughly covered the northern two-thirds of the modern county of Powys and part of today's English West Midlands (see map). More precisely, and based on the Romano-British tribal lands of the Ordovices in the west and the Cornovii in the east, its boundaries originally extended from the Cambrian Mountains in the west to include the modern West Midlands region of England in the east. The fertile river valleys of the Severn and Tern are found there, and this region is referred to in later Welsh literature as "the Paradise of Powys" (an epithet retained in Welsh for the modern UK county).

Kraljevina Škotska je bila suverena država v severozahodni Evropi, ki naj bi bila po izročilu ustanovljena leta 843. Njeno ozemlje se je širilo in krčilo, sčasoma pa je zavzela severno tretjino otoka Velika Britanija in na jugu mejila na Kraljevino Anglijo. V srednjem veku se je Škotska občasno vojskovala z Anglijo, najbolj znane so škotske osamosvojitvene vojne, v katerih so Škoti ohranili in uveljavili svojo neodvisnost od Angležev. Ko si je Škotska leta 1266 od Norveške priključila Hebride in leta 1472 Severne otoke, Anglija pa leta 1482 zavzela Berwick, je ozemlje Kraljevine Škotske ustrezalo današnji Škotski, ki jo na vzhodu omejuje Severno morje, na severu in zahodu Atlantski ocean, na jugozahodu pa Severni preliv in Irsko morje.

source.title: Kingdom of Scotland
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Scotland was a sovereign state in northwest Europe, traditionally said to have been founded in 843. Its territories expanded and shrank, but it came to occupy the northern third of the island of Great Britain, sharing a land border to the south with the Kingdom of England. During the Middle Ages, Scotland engaged in intermittent conflict with England, most prominently the Wars of Scottish Independence, which saw the Scots maintain and assert their independence from the English. Following Scotland's annexation of the Hebrides and the Northern Isles from Norway in 1266 and 1472 respectively, and England's capture of Berwick in 1482, the territory of the Kingdom of Scotland corresponded to that of modern-day Scotland, bounded by the North Sea to the east, the Atlantic Ocean to the north and west, and the North Channel and Irish Sea to the southwest.

Kraljestvo Južnih Sasov, danes imenovano Kraljestvo Sussex, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo, eno od sedmih tradicionalnih kraljestev anglosaške Anglije. Na južni obali otoka Velika Britanija je bilo sprva saška kolonija iz 6. stoletja, pozneje pa samostojno kraljestvo.

Kraljestvo ostaja ena najmanj znanih anglosaških političnih tvorb: ohranjenega seznama kraljev ni, imelo je več krajevnih vladarjev in je bilo manj centralizirano od drugih anglosaških kraljestev. Južnim Sasom so vladali kralji Sussexa, dokler deželo verjetno leta 827, po bitki pri Ellendunu, ni priključil Wessex. Leta 860 so Sussexu vladali wessexški kralji, do leta 927 pa so vladali vsem preostalim anglosaškim kraljestvom kot delom novega Kraljestva Anglija.

source.title: Kingdom of Sussex
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the South Saxons, today referred to as the Kingdom of Sussex, was an early medieval English kingdom, constituting one of the seven traditional kingdoms of Anglo-Saxon England. On the south coast of the island of Great Britain, it was originally a sixth-century Saxon colony and later an independent kingdom.

The kingdom remains one of the least known of the Anglo-Saxon polities, with no surviving king-list, several local rulers and less centralisation than other Anglo-Saxon kingdoms. The South Saxons were ruled by the kings of Sussex until the country was annexed by Wessex, probably in 827, in the aftermath of the Battle of Ellendun. In 860 Sussex was ruled by the kings of Wessex, and by 927 all remaining Anglo-Saxon kingdoms were ruled by them as part of the new kingdom of England.

Kingdom of the Isles.headline: Kraljestvo otokov
paragraphs: Kraljestvo otokov je bilo nordijsko-gelsko kraljestvo, ki je od 9. do 13. stoletja obsegalo otok Man, Hebride in otoke v zalivu Clyde. Imenujejo ga tudi Sodor ali Sudreys, po staronordijskem imenu Suðreyjar, »južni otoki«, v nasprotju z Norðreyjar, severnimi otoki Orkney in Shetland. Nekatere poznejše vladarje so imenovali kralji Mana in otokov. Zgodovinski viri so nepopolni in kraljestvo v vsem obdobju ni bilo neprekinjena celota. Občasno je bilo neodvisno od zunanjega nadzora, čeprav so bili otoki večji del obdobja norveško odvisno ozemlje, njihovi vladarji pa so imeli nadoblastnike na Norveškem, Orkneyju ali Irskem. Kot kaže, so si občasno celotno ozemlje ali njegove dele lastili tudi tekmeci. Otoki imajo skupno več kot 8300 kvadratnih kilometrov kopnega in se raztezajo več kot 500 kilometrov od severa proti jugu.
notes: The square-mile and mile conversions are dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of the Isles
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the Isles was a Norse–Gaelic kingdom comprising the Isle of Man, the Hebrides and the islands of the Clyde from the 9th to the 13th centuries. It is also called Sodor or the Sudreys, from its Old Norse name Suðreyjar, or "Southern Isles"; as distinct from the Norðreyjar or Northern Isles of Orkney and Shetland. Some of its later rulers were referred to as kings of Mann and the Isles. The historical record is incomplete, and the kingdom was not a continuous entity throughout the whole period. At times it was independent of outside control, although for much of the period the Isles were a Norwegian dependency and its rulers had overlords in Norway, Orkney, or Ireland. At times there also appear to have been competing claims for all or parts of the territory. The islands have a total land area of over 8,300 square kilometres (3,205 sq mi) and extend for more than 500 kilometres (310 mi) from north to south.

Kraljestvo Suebov (latinsko: Regnum Suevorum), imenovano tudi Kraljestvo Galicija (latinsko: Regnum Galicia) ali suebsko kraljestvo Galicija (latinsko: Galicia suevorum regnum), je bilo germansko porimsko kraljestvo, eno prvih, ki so se odcepila od Rimskega cesarstva. Dejansko kraljestvo s središčem v nekdanjih rimskih provincah Galecija in severna Luzitanija so Suebi ustanovili okoli leta 409, v 6. stoletju pa je postalo formalno razglašeno kraljestvo, ki se je istovetilo z Galecijo. Neodvisnost je ohranilo do leta 585, ko so ga priključili Vizigoti in ga spremenili v šesto provinco Vizigotskega kraljestva v Hispaniji.

source.title: Kingdom of the Suebi
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the Suebi (Latin: Regnum Suevorum), also called the Kingdom of Galicia (Latin: Regnum Galicia) or Suebi Kingdom of Galicia (Latin: Galicia suevorum regnum), was a Germanic post-Roman kingdom that was one of the first to separate from the Roman Empire. Based in the former Roman provinces of Gallaecia and northern Lusitania, the de facto kingdom was established by the Suebi about 409, and during the 6th century it became a formally declared kingdom identifying with Gallaecia. It maintained its independence until 585, when it was annexed by the Visigoths, and was turned into the sixth province of the Visigothic Kingdom in Hispania.

Nacionalistična frakcija (špansko: Bando nacional), imenovana tudi uporniška frakcija (Bando sublevado) in frankistična frakcija (Bando franquista), je bila glavna stran v španski državljanski vojni v letih 1936–1939. Sestavljale so jo različne desničarske politične skupine, ki so podprle španski državni udar julija 1936 proti drugi španski republiki in republikanski strani ter hotele odstaviti Manuela Azaño. Vključevala je Falange Española de las JONS, CEDA (»Španska konfederacija avtonomne desnice«) in dve monarhistični skupini, ki sta podpirali tekmeca za prestol: alfonsistično Renovación Española (Španska prenova) in karlistično Comunión Tradicionalista (Tradicionalistično občestvo). Dekret o združitvi je leta 1937 vse te skupine združil v FET y de las JONS. Med vojno so se nacionalistične skupine, ki so kazale nekatere »fašizoidne« in »predfašistične« težnje, poenotile okoli novega ideološkega projekta, ki sta ga zaznamovala sodoben ultranacionalizem in cilj narod očistiti in preroditi v »grmadi« vojne ter po zgledu italijanskega fašizma ustvariti španskega »novega človeka«.

source.title: Nationalist faction (Spanish Civil War)
paragraphs: The Nationalist faction (Spanish: Bando nacional), also called the Rebel faction (Spanish: Bando sublevado) and Francoist faction (Spanish: Bando franquista), was a major faction in the Spanish Civil War of 1936 to 1939. It was composed of a variety of right-wing political groups that supported the Spanish coup of July 1936 against the Second Spanish Republic and Republican faction and sought to depose Manuel Azaña. It included the Falange Española de las JONS, the CEDA ('Spanish Confederation of the Autonomous Right'), and two rival monarchist claimants: the Alfonsist Spanish Renovation and the Carlist Traditionalist Communion. In 1937, the Unification Decree merged all these groups into the FET y de las JONS. In the course of the war, the Nationalist groups, which exhibited certain "fascisant" and "pre-fascist" tendencies, became unified around a new emerging ideological project marked by modern ultranationalism and the goal of purifying and reviving the nation in the "bonfire" of the war to achieve a Spanish "New Man" similarly to Italian Fascism.

North Sea Empire.headline: Severnomorski imperij
paragraphs: Severnomorski imperij, znan tudi kot anglo-skandinavski imperij, je bil personalna unija kraljestev Anglije, Danske in Norveške v večjem delu obdobja med letoma 1013 in 1042, proti koncu vikinške dobe. Ta kratkotrajni imperij pod nordijsko oblastjo je bil talasokracija, katere dele je povezovalo le morje in so bili od njega odvisni.

Prvi kralj, ki je združil vsa tri kraljestva, je bil Sven Vilobradi, danski kralj od leta 986 in norveški od leta 1000: to mu je uspelo, ko je leta 1013 osvojil Anglijo. Umrl je naslednje leto in njegovo kraljestvo je bilo razdeljeno. Njegov sin Knut Veliki je leta 1016 pridobil Anglijo, leta 1018 Dansko in leta 1028 Norveško. Umrl je leta 1035 in kraljestvo je bilo znova razdeljeno, toda njegov naslednik na Danskem, Hardeknut, je leta 1040 podedoval Anglijo in ji vladal do svoje smrti leta 1042. Na vrhuncu moči, ko je vladal vsem trem kraljestvom (1028–1035), je bil Knut za cesarjem Svetega rimskega cesarstva najmočnejši vladar zahodne Evrope.

source.title: North Sea Empire
paragraphs: The North Sea Empire, also known as the Anglo-Scandinavian Empire, was the personal union of the kingdoms of England, Denmark and Norway for most of the period between 1013 and 1042 towards the end of the Viking Age. This ephemeral Norse-ruled empire was a thalassocracy, its components only connected by and dependent upon the sea.

The first king to unite all three kingdoms was Sweyn Forkbeard, king of Denmark since 986 and of Norway since 1000, when he conquered England in 1013. He died in the following year, and his realm was divided. His son Cnut the Great acquired England in 1016, Denmark in 1018 and Norway in 1028. He died in 1035 and his realm was again divided, but his successor in Denmark, Harthacnut, inherited England in 1040 and ruled it until his death in 1042. At the height of his power, when Cnut ruled all three kingdoms (1028–1035), he was the most powerful ruler in western Europe after the Holy Roman Emperor.

Pallars Jussà je comarca (okraj) v pokrajini Alt Pirineu v Kataloniji v Španiji. Kot comarca je bila ustanovljena leta 1936 iz dela stare grofije Pallars. Ime je arhaizem in pomeni »spodnji Pallars«; severovzhodno od nje, v gorah, leži Pallars Sobirà. Glavno mesto in največja občina je Tremp.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is a medieval state, but its link points to the article on the modern comarca; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Pallars Jussà
paragraphs: Pallars Jussà (Western Catalan: [paˈʎa(ɾ)z ʒuˈsa]) is a comarca (county) in Alt Pirineu, Catalonia, Spain. It was established as a comarca in 1936, out of the old county of Pallars. The name is an archaism meaning "Lower Pallars"; to the northeast and into the mountains is Pallars Sobirà. Its capital and largest municipality is Tremp.

Pallars Sobirà je comarca (okraj) v severozahodnem delu pokrajine Alt Pirineu v Kataloniji v Španiji. Ime pomeni »zgornji Pallars« in jo loči od bolj naseljene (in manj gorate) comarce Pallars Jussà na jugozahodu. Glavno mesto in največja občina je Sort.

Pallars Sobirà leži v osrednjih Pirenejih in se razteza od juga proti severu, od soteske Collegats do vasi Alós d'Isil, ob toku reke Noguera Pallaresa. Po površini je četrta največja comarca v Kataloniji in ima eno najnižjih gostot prebivalstva v državi, okoli 5,1 prebivalca na km². Skupaj ima približno 7000 prebivalcev.
V Pallars Sobirà ležita največje jezero v Pirenejih, jezero Certascan, in najvišji vrh Katalonije, Pica d'Estats (3143 m).
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is a medieval state, but its link points to the article on the modern comarca; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Pallars Sobirà
paragraphs: Pallars Sobirà (Western Catalan: [paˈʎa(ɾ)s soβiˈɾa]) is a comarca (county) in the northwest region of Alt Pirineu, in Catalonia, Spain. The name means "Upper Pallars", distinguishing it from the more populous (and less mountainous) Pallars Jussà to its southwest. Its capital and largest municipality is Sort.

Located in the central Pyrenees, Pallars Sobirà stretches from south to north, starting at the gorge of Collegats to the village of Alós d'Isil, following the course of the river Noguera Pallaresa. It is the fourth biggest comarca in Catalonia in terms of surface area, and has one of the lowest densities of population in the country, about 5.1 inhabitants per km². All together, it has approximately 7,000 inhabitants.
Pallars Sobirà contains the largest lake in the Pyrenees, the lake of Certascan, and the highest peak in Catalonia, the Pica d'Estats (3,143 m).

Powys Fadog.headline: Powys Fadog
paragraphs: Severni Powys ali Powys Fadog (valižansko »Madogov Powys«) je bil severni del Kraljestva Powys po njegovem razpadu leta 1160. Gospodje severnega Powysa so imeli kraljevi sedež v gradu Dinas Brân, versko središče pa v opatiji Valle Crucis. Med njegovimi gospostvi so bila Maelor, Mochnant, Glyndyfrdwy, Yale ter Bromfield in Yale.

Po razdelitvi Powysa je imela sorodna veja, knezi Powysa Wenwynwyn, sedež v gradu Powis. Prvi knez kneževine je bil Gruffydd Maelor I., zadnji suvereni knez pa Madog II. ap Gruffydd, nato je sledila osvojitev Walesa pod kraljem Edvardom Dolgonogim.

source.title: Northern Powys (medieval)
paragraphs: Northern Powys or Powys Fadog (Welsh for 'Madog's Powys'), was the northern portion of the Kingdom of Powys following that kingdom's dissolution in 1160. The lords of northern Powys had their royal seat at Castell Dinas Brân and their religious center at Valle Crucis Abbey. Some of its lordships included those of Maelor, Mochnant, Glyndyfrdwy, Yale, and Bromfield and Yale.

Following the division of Powys, their cousin branch, the princes of Powys Wenwynwyn, had their seat at Powis Castle. The principality's first prince was Gruffydd Maelor I, and its last sovereign prince was Madog II ap Gruffydd, following the Conquest of Wales by king Edward Longshanks.

Powys Wenwynwyn.headline: Powys Wenwynwyn
paragraphs: Južni Powys ali Powys Wenwynwyn (valižansko »Gwenwynwynov Powys«) je bil valižansko gospostvo v visokem srednjem veku. Obsegal je južni del nekdanje kneževine Powys, ki je razpadla po smrti Madoga ap Maredudda in umoru njegovega dediča Llywelyna leta 1160: severni del (Maelor) je dobil Gruffydd Maelor in sčasoma se je zanj uveljavilo ime Powys Fadog, južni del (Cyfeiliog) pa Owain Cyfeiliog in zanj se je sčasoma uveljavilo ime Powys Wenwynwyn, po knezu Gwenwynwynu ab Owainu, drugem vladarju.
Južni Powys in Gwynedd sta v naslednjih letih postala zagrizena tekmeca, pri čemer se je prvi pogosto povezoval z Anglijo, da bi oslabil drugega.

source.title: Southern Powys (medieval)
paragraphs: Southern Powys or Powys Wenwynwyn (Welsh for 'Gwenwynwyn's Powys'), was a Welsh lordship which existed during the high Middle Ages. The realm was the southern portion of the former princely state of Powys which split following the death of Madog ap Maredudd and the killing of his heir Llywelyn in 1160: the northern portion (Maelor) went to Gruffydd Maelor and eventually became known as Powys Fadog; while the southern portion (Cyfeiliog) going to Owain Cyfeiliog and becoming known, eventually, as Powys Wenwynwyn after Prince Gwenwynwyn ab Owain, its second ruler.
Southern Powys and Gwynedd became bitter rivals in the years that followed, with the former frequently allying itself with England to further its aims of weakening the latter.

Rheged je bil eno od kraljestev Hen Ogledd (»starega severa«), britonsko govorečega območja današnje severne Anglije in južne Škotske v porimskem obdobju in zgodnjem srednjem veku. Omenja ga več pesniških in bardskih virov, a nobeden ne opisuje njegovih meja. Arheološka izkopavanja na najdišču v Gallowayu na Škotskem, ki potekajo od leta 2012, izkopavalci razlagajo kot dokaz, da gre za kraljevo središče Rhegeda. Rheged je morda segal v Lancashire in druge dele severne Anglije. V nekaterih virih je tesno povezan s kraljem Urienom Rhegedom in njegovo družino. Prebivalci so govorili kumbrijsko, britonsko narečje, tesno sorodno stari valižanščini.
notes: The Welsh pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Rheged
paragraphs: Rheged (Welsh pronunciation: [ˈr̥ɛɡɛd]) was one of the kingdoms of the Hen Ogledd ('Old North'), the Brittonic-speaking region of what is now Northern England and southern Scotland, during the post-Roman era and Early Middle Ages. It is recorded in several poetic and bardic sources, although its borders are not described in any of them. Archaeological work from 2012 onwards on a site in Galloway in Scotland is interpreted by the excavators as showing that it is a royal centre of Rheged. Rheged possibly extended into Lancashire and other parts of northern England. In some sources, Rheged is intimately associated with the king Urien Rheged and his family. Its inhabitants spoke Cumbric, a Brittonic dialect closely related to Old Welsh.

Seisyllwg je bil majhno kraljestvo srednjeveškega Walesa. Ni jasno, kdaj je nastal kot samostojna enota, po poznejših virih pa ga je sestavljalo nekdanje Kraljestvo Ceredigion skupaj z območjem Ystrad Tywi. Obsegal je torej današnjo grofijo Ceredigion, del Carmarthenshira in polotok Gower. Ime je očitno dobil po Seisyllu, kralju Ceredigiona v 7. ali začetku 8. stoletja, ni pa znano, ali ga je neposredno ustanovil on. V 10. stoletju je Seisyllwg postal središče moči Hywela Dobrega, ki je zavladal večini Walesa. Leta 920 je Hywel združil Seisyllwg s Kraljestvom Dyfed v novo kraljestvo Deheubarth.
notes: The Welsh pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Seisyllwg
paragraphs: Seisyllwg (Welsh: [sɛiˈsəɬʊɡ]) was a petty kingdom of medieval Wales. It is unclear when it emerged as a distinct unit, but according to later sources it consisted of the former Kingdom of Ceredigion plus the region known as Ystrad Tywi. Thus it covered the modern county of Ceredigion, part of Carmarthenshire, and the Gower Peninsula. It is evidently named after Seisyll, king of Ceredigion in the 7th or early 8th century, but it is unknown if he was directly responsible for its establishment. In the 10th century Seisyllwg became the centre of power for Hywel Dda, who came to rule most of Wales. In 920 Hywel merged Seisyllwg with the Kingdom of Dyfed to form the new kingdom of Deheubarth.

Strathclyde.headline: Strathclyde
paragraphs: Strathclyde (gelsko: Srath Chluaidh, »dolina reke Clyde«) je bila ena od devetih nekdanjih lokalnih upravnih regij Škotske. Ustanovljena je bila leta 1975 na podlagi zakona o lokalni upravi na Škotskem iz leta 1973 in odpravljena leta 1996 na podlagi zakona o lokalni upravi na Škotskem iz leta 1994. Regija Strathclyde je imela 19 okrožij. Ime je dobila po zgodnjesrednjeveškem Kraljestvu Strathclyde s središčem v Govanu, a je obsegala širše območje od svoje soimenjakinje, saj je poleg jugozahodnega jedra vključevala še Argyll in različne zahodne otoke.
notes: The Gaelic pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is the medieval Kingdom of Strathclyde, but its link points to the article on the modern local government region; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Strathclyde
paragraphs: Strathclyde (Srath Chluaidh [s̪t̪ɾa ˈxl̪ˠɯi] in Gaelic, meaning 'strath [valley] of the River Clyde') was one of nine former local government regions of Scotland created in 1975 by the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973 and abolished in 1996 by the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994. The Strathclyde region had 19 districts. The region was named after the early medieval Kingdom of Strathclyde centred on Govan, but covered a broader geographic area than its namesake by including Argyll and various Western islands in addition to its Southwestern core.

Taifa of Albarracín.headline: Taifa Albarracín
paragraphs: Taifa Albarracín (arabsko: طائفة بني رزين) je bila srednjeveško berbersko taifsko kraljestvo. Obstajala je od leta 1012 do 1104 s središčem v mestu Albarracín. Vodila jo je berberska dinastija plemena Banu Razin, ki je na polotok prišlo po osvojitvi Španije pod Tarikom ibn Zijadom.

source.title: Taifa of Albarracín
paragraphs: The Taifa of Albarracín (Arabic: طائفة بني رزين) was a medieval Berber taifa kingdom. The polity existed from 1012 to 1104, and was centered at the city of Albarracín. It was led by the Berber dynasty of the Banu Razin tribe, which arrived in the peninsula after the conquest of Spain by Tariq ibn Ziyad.
Algeciraška taifa (arabsko: طائفة الجزيرة) je bila srednjeveško muslimansko taifsko kraljestvo na območju današnje južne Španije in Gibraltarja, ki je obstajalo od leta 1035 do 1058.

source.title: Taifa of Algeciras
paragraphs: The Taifa of Algeciras (Arabic: طائفة الجزيرة) was a medieval Muslim taifa kingdom in what is now southern Spain and Gibraltar, that existed from 1035 to 1058.

Taifa of Almería.headline: Taifa Almería
paragraphs: Taifa Almería (arabsko: طائفة المرية) je bila muslimansko srednjeveško arabsko kraljestvo na območju današnje province Almería v Španiji. Nastala je leta 1012 in obstajala do leta 1091.

V tem obdobju je mesto Almería doživelo zgodovinski razcvet pod mogočnimi krajevnimi emirji, kot sta bila Hajran, prvi popolnoma neodvisni emir Almeríe in Cartagene, in Abu Jahja Mohamed ibn Man. Almería je okoli leta 1012 razglasila neodvisnost svoje province od Kordobskega kalifata. Ostala je neodvisno kraljestvo, čeprav so ji pohodi seviljske taife zmanjšali ozemlje na severu.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Taifa of Almería
paragraphs: The Taifa of Almería (Arabic: طائفة المرية, Ta'ifa al-Mariyah) was a Muslim medieval Arab kingdom located in what is now the province of Almería in Spain. The taifa originated in 1012 and lasted until 1091.

In this period the city of Almería reached its historical splendour under powerful local emirs like Khayran, the first fully independent Emir of Almería and Cartagena, and Abu Yahyà Muhammad ibn Ma'n. Almería declared independence of its province from Caliphate of Cordoba around 1012. It remained as an independent kingdom, although several campaigns of the Taifa of Seville diminished its territory in the north.

Taifa of Alpuente.headline: Taifa Alpuente
paragraphs: Taifa Alpuente (arabsko: طائفة ألبونت) je bila srednjeveško taifsko kraljestvo berberskega izvora, ki je obstajalo od okoli leta 1009 do 1106 in je nastalo po koncu Kordobskega kalifata na Iberskem polotoku leta 1010. Središče je imela v mestu Alpuente, vladala pa ji je berberska rodbina iz plemena Banu Kasim.

source.title: Taifa of Alpuente
paragraphs: The Taifa of Alpuente (Arabic: طائفة ألبونت) was a medieval taifa kingdom, of Berber origin, that existed from around 1009 to 1106 created following the end of the Caliphate of Córdoba in the Iberian Peninsula in 1010. It was centered at the city of Alpuente. It was ruled by a Berber family of the Banu Qasim tribe.

Taifa of Arcos.headline: Taifa Arcos
paragraphs: Taifa Arcos (arabsko: طائفة أركش) je bila berbersko srednjeveško taifsko kraljestvo, ki je obstajalo v dveh obdobjih. Prvič je obstajala od leta 1011 do 1068, ko ji je vladala zenatska berberska rodbina Banu Džizrun. Od leta 1068 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom Sevilje pod Abadom II. al Mutadidom. Neodvisna je bila znova od leta 1143 do 1145, ko jo je dokončno osvojil Almohadski kalifat.

Banu Džizrun iz berberske zenatske konfederacije so pod vodstvom Mohameda I. zavzeli koro (okraj) Sidonia, potem ko so izgnali umajadskega upravitelja, ki ji je vladal. Dinastija je razglasila neodvisnost in leta 1011 ustanovila kraljestvo taifo Arcos s prestolnico v današnjem mestu Arcos de la Frontera.

source.title: Taifa of Arcos
paragraphs: The Taifa of Arcos (Arabic: طائفة أركش) was a Berber medieval taifa kingdom that existed in two periods; first from 1011 to 1068. Ruled by the Zanata Berber family of the Banū Jizrūn. From 1068 until 1091 it was under the forcible control of Seville, by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid. It regained its independence from 1143 to 1145 when it was finally conquered by the Almohad Caliphate.

The Banū Jizrūn, belonging to the Berber Zanata confederation, led by Muhammad I, seized the cora of Sidonia after expelling the Umayyad governor that ruled. The dynasty proclaimed its independence, giving rise to the kingdom Taifa of Arcos in 1011, with its capital in the present city of Arcos de la Frontera.

Taifa of Badajoz.headline: Taifa Badajoz
paragraphs: Taifa Badajoz (arabsko: طائفة بطليوس) je bila srednjeveško islamsko mavrsko kraljestvo na ozemlju današnje Portugalske in Španije. Središče je imela v mestu Badajoz, ki je danes največje mesto Extremadure v Španiji.

source.title: Taifa of Badajoz
paragraphs: The Taifa of Badajoz (from Arabic: طائفة بطليوس) was a medieval Islamic Moorish kingdom located in what is now parts of Portugal and Spain. It was centred on the city of Badajoz which exists today as the first city of Extremadura, in Spain.

Taifa of Carmona.headline: Taifa Carmona
paragraphs: Taifa Carmona (arabsko: طائفة قرمونة) je bila srednjeveško berbersko taifsko kraljestvo. Obstajala je v dveh ločenih obdobjih: prvič od leta 1013 do 1066, ko jo je osvojila seviljska taifa, in drugič od okoli leta 1143 do 1150, ko jo je dokončno osvojil Almohadski kalifat. Taifo je ustanovila in ji vladala zenatska berberska dinastija Birzalidov.

source.title: Taifa of Carmona
paragraphs: The Taifa of Carmona (Arabic: طائفة قرمونة) was a medieval Berber taifa kingdom. It existed for two distinct periods: first from 1013 to 1066 when it was conquered by the Taifa of Seville, and secondly from around 1143 to 1150 when it was finally conquered by the Almohad Caliphate. The taifa was established and ruled by the Zenata Berber Birzalid dynasty.

Taifa of Córdoba.headline: Taifa Córdoba
paragraphs: Taifa Córdoba (arabsko: طائفة قرطبة) je bila arabska taifa, ki ji je vladala rodbina Banu Džahvar, ta pa je leta 1031 nadomestila umajadskega kalifa kot oblast v Córdobi in okolici.

source.title: Taifa of Córdoba
paragraphs: The Taifa of Córdoba (Arabic: طائفة قرطبة) was an Arab taifa which was ruled by the Banu Jahwar that replaced the Umayyad Caliph as the government of Córdoba and its vicinity in 1031.

Taifa of Dénia.headline: Taifa Dénia
paragraphs: Taifa Dénia (arabsko: طائفة دانية) je bila islamsko kraljestvo v srednjeveški Španiji, ki je vladalo delu valencijske obale in Ibizi. Taifa s prestolnico v Déniji je obsegala Balearske otoke in dele španske celine. Leta 1010 jo je ustanovil slovanski muslimanski vojskovodja Mudžahid al Amiri.

source.title: Taifa of Dénia
paragraphs: The taifa of Dénia (Arabic: طائفة دانية) was an Islamic kingdom in medieval Spain, ruling over part of the Valencian coast and Ibiza. With Dénia as its capital, the taifa included the Balearic Islands and parts of the Spanish mainland. It was founded in 1010 by the Slavic Muslim warlord Mujāhid al-ʿĀmirī.

Taifa Granade (arabsko: طائفة غرناطة) ali Ziridsko kraljestvo Granada je bila muslimansko kraljestvo, ki je nastalo v Al Andalusu (na ozemlju današnje Španije) leta 1013, potem ko je bil leta 1009 odstavljen umajadski kalif Hišam II. Središče kraljestva je bila prestolnica Granada, nekaj časa pa je nadzorovalo tudi Málago. V skoraj 80 letih obstoja so se zvrstili štirje kralji, vsi iz veje ziridske dinastije iz severne Afrike, berberskega klana Sanhadža. Taifa Granade je veljala za najbogatejšo od vseh taifskih kraljestev. Leta 1090 so jo osvojili Almoravidi in s tem končali ziridsko oblast v Granadi.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Taifa of Granada
paragraphs: The Taifa of Granada (Arabic: طائفة غرناطة, Ta'ifat Gharnata) or Zirid Kingdom of Granada was a Muslim kingdom that was formed in al-Andalus (in present-day Spain) in 1013 following the deposition of Umayyad Caliph Hisham II in 1009. The kingdom was centered on Granada, its capital, and it also extended its control to Málaga for a period. Four kings succeeded each other during its nearly 80 years of existence, all of them belonging to an offshoot of the Zirid dynasty of North Africa, a Sanhaja Berber clan. The Taifa of Granada was considered to be the wealthiest out of all of the taifa kingdoms. It was eventually conquered by the Almoravids in 1090, putting an end to Zirid rule in Granada.

Taifa of Morón.headline: Taifa Morón
paragraphs: Taifa Morón (arabsko: طائفة مورور) je bila srednjeveško berbersko taifsko kraljestvo, ki je obstajalo od okoli leta 1010 do 1066. Od leta 1066 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom Sevilje, ki ji je vladal Abad II. al Mutadid.

source.title: Taifa of Morón
paragraphs: The Taifa of Morón (Arabic: طائفة مورور) was a medieval Berber taifa kingdom that existed from around 1010 to 1066. From 1066 until 1091 it was under the forcible control of Seville, ruled by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid.

Taifa of Murcia.headline: Taifa Murcia
paragraphs: Taifa Murcia (arabsko: طائفة مرسية) je bila arabska taifa srednjeveškega Al Andalusa na območju današnje južne Španije. Kot taifa s središčem v mavrskem mestu Murcia je postala neodvisna po padcu Umajadskega kalifata v Córdobi (11. stoletje). Mavrska taifa Murcia je obsegala tudi Albacete in del Almeríe.

Ta taifa je, kot kaže, obstajala v največ ločenih obdobjih (petih): od leta 1011 do 1014, od 1065 do 1078, leta 1145, od 1147 do 1172 in nazadnje od 1228 do 1266, ko jo je vsrkala Kastilija in je postala Kraljestvo Murcia, eno od kraljestev Kastiljske krone.

source.title: Taifa of Murcia
paragraphs: The Taifa of Murcia (Arabic: طائفة مرسية) was an Arab taifa of medieval Al-Andalus, in what is now southern Spain. It became independent as a taifa centered on the Moorish city of Murcia after the fall of the Umayyad Caliphate of Córdoba (11th century). The Moorish Taifa of Murcia included Albacete and part of Almería as well.

The taifa is apparently the one that existed the greatest number of separate time periods (five): from 1011 to 1014, from 1065 to 1078, in 1145, from 1147 to 1172 and finally from 1228 to 1266 when it was absorbed by Castile, becoming the Kingdom of Murcia, one of the constituent kingdoms of the Crown of Castile.

Taifa of Niebla.headline: Taifa Niebla
paragraphs: Taifa Niebla (arabsko: طائفة لبلة) je bila arabsko taifsko kraljestvo, ki je obstajalo v treh ločenih obdobjih: od leta 1023 do 1053, od 1145 do 1150 in od 1234 do 1262.
Od leta 1053 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom seviljske taife pod Abadom II. al Mutadidom. Nazadnje jo je osvojila Kastiljska krona, ki si jo je leta 1262 dokončno priključila.

source.title: Taifa of Niebla
paragraphs: The Taifa of Niebla (Arabic: طائفة لبلة) was an Arab taifa kingdom that existed during three distinct time periods: from 1023 to 1053, from 1145 to 1150 and from 1234 to 1262.
From 1053 until 1091 it was under the forcible control of Taifa of Seville, by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid. It was finally conquered by the Crown of Castile. In 1262 it was eventually absorbed by Castile.

Taifa of Ronda.headline: Taifa Ronda
paragraphs: Taifa Ronda (arabsko: طائفة رندة) je bila srednjeveško berbersko taifsko kraljestvo v mavrskem Al Andalusu na območju današnje južne Španije. Obstajala je od leta 1039 do 1065. Vladala ji je rodbina iz berberskega plemena Banu Ifran iz severne Afrike, prestolnica pa je bilo mesto Ronda. Od leta 1065 do 1091 je bila pod nadzorom seviljske taife, ki jo je vodil Abad II. al Mutadid.

source.title: Taifa of Ronda
paragraphs: The Taifa of Ronda (Arabic: طائفة رندة) was a medieval Berber taifa kingdom centered in Moorish al-Andalus in what is now southern Spain. It existed from 1039 to 1065. The taifa was ruled by a family from the Berber Banu Ifran tribe of North Africa. Its capital was the city of Ronda. From 1065 until 1091, the taifa was under the control of the Taifa of Seville, led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid.

Taifa Saltés in Huelva (arabsko: طائفة ولبة وشلطيش) je bila srednjeveško arabsko taifsko kraljestvo na jugu Iberskega polotoka, ki je obstajalo od okoli leta 1012 do 1051. Od leta 1051 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom Sevilje pod Abadom II. al Mutadidom.
V taifi Saltés in Huelva se je rodil geograf al Bakri (u. 1094).

source.title: Taifa of Saltés and Huelva
paragraphs: The Taifa of Saltés and Huelva (Arabic: طائفة ولبة وشلطيش) was a medieval Arab taifa kingdom that existed in southern Iberia from around 1012 to 1051. From 1051 until 1091 it was under the forcible control of Seville, by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid.
The geographer al-Bakri (d. 1094) was born in the taifa of Saltés and Huelva.

Taifa Santa Maria do Algarve (arabsko: شنتمرية الغرب, Šantamarija al Garb) je bila srednjeveško islamsko taifsko mavrsko kraljestvo ali emirat na območju današnje južne Portugalske, ki je obstajalo od leta 1018 do 1051. Od leta 1051 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom Sevilje pod Abadom II. al Mutadidom. Potomci vladarjev, znanih kot Banu Harun, so ostali kadiji mesta, dokler ga leta 1249 ni znova osvojila Portugalska; zadnji med njimi je bil Aloandro Ben Bekar.

source.title: Taifa of Santa Maria do Algarve
paragraphs: The Taifa of Santa Maria do Algarve (Arabic: شنتمرية الغرب, romanized: Shantamariyya al-Gharb) was a medieval Islamic taifa Moorish kingdom or emirate located in what is now southern Portugal, that existed from 1018 to 1051. From 1051 until 1091, it was under the forcible control of Seville via Abbad II al-Mu'tadid. Known as the Banu Harun, their descendants remained as Qadis of the city until its reconquest by Portugal in 1249, the last of whom being Aloandro Ben Bekar.

Seviljska taifa (arabsko: طائفة إشبيليّة) je bila arabsko kraljestvo, ki mu je vladala dinastija Abadidov. Nastala je leta 1023 in obstajala do leta 1091 na območju današnje južne Španije in Portugalske. Neodvisnost je pridobila od Kordobskega kalifata in sredi 11. stoletja razširila svoje ozemlje. Zaradi vzpona Kastilije je Sevilja zaprosila za vojaško pomoč Almoravide, ki so nato zasedli Seviljo.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Taifa of Seville
paragraphs: The Taifa of Seville (Arabic: طائفة إشبيليّة Ta'ifat-u Ishbiliyyah) was an Arab kingdom which was ruled by the Abbadid dynasty. It was established in 1023 and lasted until 1091, in what is today southern Spain and Portugal. It gained independence from the Caliphate of Cordoba and it expanded the territory it ruled in the mid-11th century. The emerging power of Castile led Seville to ask military assistance from the Almoravids, who then occupied Seville.

Taifa Silves (arabsko: طائفة شلب, Taifa Šilb) je bila arabsko taifsko kraljestvo na območju današnje južne Portugalske, ki je obstajalo v dveh ločenih obdobjih: od leta 1027 do 1063 in znova od 1145 do 1150, ko ga je dokončno osvojil Almohadski kalifat.

Taifa je obsegala najzahodnejši del današnje portugalske pokrajine Algarve blizu rta São Vicente, prestolnica pa je bil Silves. Taifa Silves je nastala v začetku 11. stoletja, od leta 1048 pa je imela oblast rodbina Banu Muzain s tremi emirji: Isa II. al Muzafar (1048–1053), Mohamed II. al Nasir (1053–1058) in Isa III. al Muzafar (1058–1063). Pod zadnjim je kraljestvo osvojila močnejša seviljska taifa pod vodstvom Abada II. al Mutadida.
V tako imenovanem drugem taifskem obdobju po padcu almoravidske dinastije je bil Silves sedež druge, kratkotrajne taife, ki je trajala od leta 1145 do 1150, ko so jo osvojili Almohadi.

source.title: Taifa of Silves
paragraphs: The Taifa of Silves (Arabic: طائفة شلب, Ṭā'ifa Šilb) was an Arab taifa kingdom that existed in what is now southern Portugal for two distinct periods: from 1027 to 1063, and again from 1145 to 1150, when it was finally conquered by the Almohad Caliphate.

The taifa occupied the westernmost part of the presently Portuguese region of Algarve, near Cape St. Vincent, with its capital in Silves. The Taifa of Silves was constituted in the early 11th century and starting from 1048, the power was held by the family of the Banu Muzayn, including three emirs: Isa II al-Muzaffar (1048–1053), Muhammad II al-Nasir (1053–1058), and Isa III al-Muzaffar (1058–1063). Under the latter the kingdom was conquered by the more powerful taifa of Seville, led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid.

During the so-called second taifa period, which followed the fall of the Almoravid dynasty, Silves was the seat of a second, ephemeral taifa, which lasted from 1145 to 1150, when it was conquered by the Almohads.

Toledska taifa (arabsko: طائفة طليطلة) je bila islamska politična tvorba (taifa) v osrednjem delu Iberskega polotoka v visokem srednjem veku. Vladali so ji Dununidi, berberski klan Havara. Nastala je po letu 1018 ob razpadu Kordobskega kalifata, ko so Dununidi, ki so bili že močni v deželah Santaver, Cuenca, Huete in Uclés, prevzeli nadzor nad mestom Toledo, prestolnico srednje marke Al Andalusa. S poznejšimi osvojitvami se je taifa razširila še na deželo Calatrava. Obstajala je do krščanske osvojitve Toleda leta 1085.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Taifa of Toledo
paragraphs: The Taifa of Toledo (Arabic: طائفة طليطلة, romanized: ṭa'ifat ṭulayṭula) was an Islamic polity (taifa) located in the centre of the Iberian Peninsula in the High Middle Ages. It was ruled by the Dhunnunids, a Hawwara Berber clan. It emerged after 1018 upon the fracturing of the Caliphate of Córdoba, when the Dhunnunids, already strong in the lands of Santaver, Cuenca, Huete and Uclés, seized control over the city of Toledo, the capital of the Middle March of Al-Andalus. Upon later territorial conquest, the taifa also expanded to the land of Calatrava. It lasted until the Christian conquest of Toledo in 1085.

Taifa of Tortosa.headline: Taifa Tortosa
paragraphs: Taifa Tortosa (arabsko: طائفة طرطوشة) je bila srednjeveško islamsko taifsko kraljestvo. Obstajala je v dveh ločenih obdobjih, od leta 1010 do 1060 in od 1081 do 1099. Ustanovil jo je slovanski vojskovodja Labib al Fata al Saklabi.

source.title: Taifa of Tortosa
paragraphs: The Taifa of Tortosa (Arabic: طائفة طرطوشة) was a medieval Islamic taifa kingdom. It existed for two separate periods, from 1010 to 1060 and 1081 to 1099. It was founded by the Slavic warlord Labib al-Fata al-Saqlabi.

Valencijska taifa je bila srednjeveško muslimansko kraljestvo v Valenciji in okolici v Španiji. Okoli leta 1010 se je osamosvojila od Kordobskega kalifata in je bila večino 11. stoletja samostojno majhno kraljestvo ali taifa. Leta 1065 jo je vsrkala toledska taifa, ki jo je leta 1085 osvojil leonsko-kastiljski kralj Alfonz VI. Od leta 1094 do 1099 je kraljestvu neposredno vladal kastiljski vojskovodja, znan kot El Cid, po njegovi smrti pa njegova žena Jimena, dokler ga leta 1102 niso priključili Almoravidi.

Po propadu almoravidske oblasti je Valencija leta 1145 znova postala neodvisna. Od leta 1147 do 1172 jo je nadzoroval Ibn Mardaniš, nato so jo priključili Almohadi. Ko so se Almohadi umaknili iz Al Andalusa, je bila Valencija znova neodvisna od okoli leta 1229 do 1238 pod vladavino Zajana ibn Mardaniša. Leta 1238 jo je dokončno osvojila Aragonska krona.

source.title: Taifa of Valencia
paragraphs: The Taifa of Valencia was a medieval Muslim kingdom which existed in and around Valencia, Spain. It gained independence from the Caliphate of Córdoba circa 1010 and became its own small kingdom, or Taifa, for most of the 11th century. It was absorbed by the Taifa of Toledo in 1065, which in turn fell to Alfonso VI of León and Castile in 1085. From 1094 to 1099, the kingdom was ruled directly by the Castilian military commander known as El Cid, then by his wife Jimena after his death, until being annexed by the Almoravids in 1102.

Following the collapse of Almoravid power, Valencia became independent again in 1145. From 1147 to 1172, it was under the control of Ibn Mardanish, after which it was annexed by the Almohads. When the Almohads retreated from al-Andalus, Valencia became independent once again from around 1229 to 1238 under the rule of Zayyan ibn Mardanish. It was finally conquered by the Crown of Aragon in 1238.

Taifa Sarakuste (arabsko: طائفة سرقسطة) je bila neodvisna arabska muslimanska država na vzhodu Al Andalusa (današnje Španije) s prestolnico v mestu Sarakusta (Zaragoza). Nastala je v začetku 11. stoletja kot eno od številnih taifskih kraljestev po tedanjem razpadu Kordobskega kalifata. Obstajala je do leta 1110, ko so jo priključili Almoravidi.

source.title: Taifa of Zaragoza
paragraphs: The taifa of Zaragoza (Arabic: طائفة سرقسطة) was an independent Arab Muslim state in the east of Al-Andalus (present-day Spain) with its capital in Saraqusta (Zaragoza) city. It was established in the early 11th century as one of the many Taifa kingdoms that followed the collapse of the Caliphate of Córdoba around this time. It survived until 1110, when it was annexed by the Almoravids.

Wihtwara.headline: Wihtwara
paragraphs: Wihtwara (staroangleško: Wihtware ali Wihtsætan) so bili zgodnjesrednjeveški prebivalci otoka Wight, ki meri 380 km² in leži ob južni obali Anglije. Pisci, kot je Beda, njihov izvor pripisujejo Jutom, ki so se na otok preselili med anglosaško naselitvijo Britanije. V zgodnjem srednjem veku so občasno tvorili samostojno kraljestvo; njihov zadnji kralj Arwald je umrl kot zadnji poganski anglosaški kralj. Nato je otok postal del Wessexa in pozneje Anglije.
notes: The square-mile conversion is dropped.

source.title: Wihtwara
paragraphs: Wihtwara (Old English: Wihtware or Wihtsætan) were the Early Medieval inhabitants of the Isle of Wight, a 147-square-mile (380 km2) island off the south coast of England. Writers such as Bede attribute their origin to Jutes who migrated to the island during the Anglo-Saxon settlement of Britain. They formed an independent kingdom at points in the Early Middle Ages, with their last king Arwald dying as the last heathen Anglo-Saxon king. After this point, the island became a part of Wessex and later England.
